Each daily card shows when you punched in and out, active time, breaks, deep-work stretches, app switches and a breakdown of work, social and fun. Daily limits actually block apps and websites once you hit them, helping you stay focused. Timecard 2 also reads the history your AI coding tools already keep, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI, showing when your agents worked next to when you did and what your plan is really worth at API prices. There's no account and your activity never leaves your Mac.

Key Features:

- App and Website Tracking: time per app, with browser time split into real sites

- Daily Timecard: an evening card with punch-in, deep work, breaks and switches

- Daily Limits: block apps and websites once you hit your limit

- AI Usage Tracking: see Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI activity and value

- 100% Local: no account, with history kept forever on your Mac

Timecard is a private, beautifully designed Screen Time alternative for Mac, available for a one-time $5 for the first 1,000 buyers, then $9.

apps.name: See Your Disk
apps.tagline: See what fills your Mac.
apps.description:
See Your Disk is a disk space visualizer and safe cleaner for Mac that turns your storage into a map of blocks, where every block is a folder and its size shows how much space it takes. Click a block to see what's inside, double-click to open it, and drill down through blocks inside blocks right to individual files. It splits your storage the same way Settings does, separating macOS, System Data, apps, documents and developer data so the mystery gigabytes finally have a place. Auto Clean removes only what apps rebuild on their own, such as caches, logs and build leftovers, and anything not clearly safe goes to the Trash first. You can also pick items yourself, with each one marked Safe, Review or Protected before you confirm. It finds developer clutter like Xcode DerivedData and simulators, npm, Gradle and Cargo caches, Hugging Face models and Docker data, and nothing ever leaves your Mac.

Key Features:

- Block Map: see every folder as a block sized by the space it uses

- System Data Breakdown: macOS, System Data, apps and developer data shown separately

- Auto Clean: one click removes only safe caches, logs and build leftovers

- Safe, Review or Protected: every item labelled, with Trash-first deletion

- Private and Open Source: no accounts, analytics or tracking

See Your Disk makes it easy to understand and safely reclaim Mac storage, free to download with cleaning unlocked for $4.99 a month or $19.99 once, plus a free open-source edition on GitHub.

apps.name: ASO Studio
apps.tagline: Decide. Ship. Grow.
apps.description:
ASO Studio is a native App Store research and optimization app for Mac that helps iOS developers get more downloads. It ranks every App Store category by demand, difficulty, downloads and revenue across its top 100 grossing apps, so you can find a market people already pay for. Keyword research brings all your terms into one table with live rank, seven-day momentum, demand, difficulty, estimated downloads and revenue, and who holds each term today. You can track every competitor ranking alongside you, see what your market is worth and pull the feature requests their users keep repeating. Next Release picks the one search worth winning, writes your title, subtitle and keywords and sends them to App Store Connect, while storefront analysis shows which countries to target next. You can also connect Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor to let your AI agent run your ASO, and manage Apple Search Ads from the same app.

Key Features:

- Market Research: every App Store category ranked by demand, difficulty and revenue

- Keyword Research: live rank, momentum, difficulty and download value in one table

- Competitor Tracking: see every rival app ranking alongside you

- Next Release: picks the best keyword and writes your title, subtitle and keywords

- AI Agent Integration: let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor run your ASO

ASO Studio gives indie developers a complete App Store growth toolkit on the Mac, with a founder price of $59 per year.

apps.name: Rushilo
apps.tagline: AI video editing with Claude Code and Codex.
apps.description:
Rushilo is a video editor for Mac and Windows that you drive with your own AI. Connect Claude Code, Codex, Claude Desktop, Cursor or your own API keys, then simply describe the edits you want and watch them happen on a visible timeline you can still adjust by hand. Rushilo generates captions with Whisper running on your device, and its Board lets you plan your cuts with notes, generate images with OpenAI and add voiceovers with ElevenLabs. Every change is tracked in an undo history, so you can experiment freely and roll back any AI edit. Because Rushilo uses the AI subscriptions and keys you already have, it doesn't sell AI credits or lock you into another monthly plan.

Key Features:

- AI-Driven Editing: describe edits to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or your API keys

- Visible Timeline: see and fine-tune every change the AI makes

- On-Device Captions: accurate subtitles generated locally with Whisper

- Planning Board: notes, OpenAI images and ElevenLabs voiceovers in one place

- Undo History: roll back any edit and experiment without risk

Rushilo brings agent-powered video editing to your desktop using the AI you already pay for, for a one-time $99 with no AI credits to buy.

apps.name: SpaceWise
apps.tagline: Reclaim the storage your dev tools quietly eat.
apps.description:
SpaceWise is a storage cleaner built specifically for developers on macOS and Windows. It scans your drive and shows exactly how much space your development tools are using, then lets you safely clean it up. SpaceWise finds and removes forgotten node_modules folders, Docker images and volumes, Xcode builds, DerivedData and old simulators, IDE and AI model caches from Cursor, VS Code, Ollama and Hugging Face, and toolchain caches from Cargo, NuGet, pip and Gradle. It can also spot dormant repositories you haven't touched in a long time. Everything runs 100% locally with zero telemetry, so nothing about your projects ever leaves your machine. The free edition includes full scans and up to 1.5 GB of cleanup, while Pro unlocks unlimited cleaning on up to three devices.

Key Features:

- Developer Storage Scan: see how much space Node, Docker, Xcode and toolchains use

- node_modules and Docker Cleanup: remove stale dependencies, images and volumes

- Xcode Cleanup: clear builds, DerivedData and old simulators

- AI and IDE Caches: free space from Cursor, VS Code, Ollama and Hugging Face

- 100% Local: zero telemetry, with dormant repo detection

SpaceWise helps developers win back gigabytes of hidden storage, free to scan and clean up to 1.5 GB, with Pro at $7.99 one-time for three devices.

apps.name: Arazio
apps.tagline: Convert any file without leaving Finder.
apps.description:
Arazio is a menu bar file converter for Mac that lets you convert files straight from your mouse without opening a separate app or uploading anything. Just drag a file onto Arazio, hold Shift to pick an output format or hold Option to open its tools, and the converted file lands right next to the original. It supports 283 conversions across 43 formats covering images, video, audio, documents and archives. Beyond converting, Arazio can compress, resize and crop media, merge and split PDFs, and trim or transform video and audio files. You can drop in whole folders for batch conversion, and everything is processed locally on your Mac, so your files never leave your computer.

Key Features:

- Drag-and-Drop Conversion: convert files from the menu bar without opening an app

- 283 Conversions: 43 formats across images, video, audio, documents and archives

- Built-In Tools: compress, resize, crop, merge and split PDFs, video and audio

- Batch Folders: convert entire folders of files in one go

- Fully Local: no uploads, with output saved right next to the original

Arazio turns file conversion into a quick drag-and-drop from your menu bar, with a $5 launch price (normally $10).

apps.name: Split
apps.tagline: Your Mac windows, arranged in seconds.
apps.description:
Split is a lightweight window manager that lives in your Mac's menu bar and arranges your windows side by side in seconds. Snap windows into place with keyboard shortcuts or simply drag them to the edge of the screen, then choose flexible split ratios instead of being stuck with a fixed 50/50 layout. When two windows share the screen, dragging the divider resizes both at once so they always fill the space neatly. You can swap the two sides instantly, use the front-window switcher to pick which app takes the other half, and get smart app-pairing suggestions based on how you work, all learned privately on your Mac. Split is built for macOS 13 or later and stays out of the way until you need it.

Key Features:

- Snap Shortcuts and Drag: arrange windows with keyboard shortcuts or drag-to-snap

- Flexible Ratios: split your screen in custom proportions, not just 50/50

- Linked Divider: resize both windows together by dragging the divider

- Swap and Switch: flip sides instantly and choose the front window for each half

- Private App Pairing: on-device suggestions for apps you use together

Split makes side-by-side multitasking on the Mac fast and effortless, for a one-time $4.99 lifetime license.

apps.name: Agent Limit
apps.tagline: Every AI limit. Right in your notch.
apps.description:
Agent Limit is a Mac app that sits beside your MacBook's notch and shows how much of your Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok allowance is left, and whether you'll run out before it resets. While an AI tool is working, a quiet pill with a ring and percentage appears next to the notch and disappears when nothing is running. Hover and the notch opens to show session and weekly meters, reset times, token counts and the project you're working on, and you can scroll to switch between tools. Instead of just a percentage, Agent Limit compares your usage with the time that has passed and tells you plainly whether you're on track, ahead of pace or going to run out, and at what time. At 75%, 90% and 100% the notch slides down with a short alert, and it lets you know again when the window resets. For Cursor it shows billing-cycle and on-demand spend, and for Grok your monthly API spend against a budget you set.

Key Features:

- Notch Usage Pill: a ring and percentage beside the notch while your AI tools are working

- Detailed Meters: session and weekly usage, reset times and project info on hover

- Pace Prediction: on track, ahead of pace or the exact time you'll run out

- Notch Alerts: heads-ups at 75%, 90% and 100%, plus a reset notice

- Multi-Tool Support: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor spend and Grok API budget

Agent Limit keeps every AI coding limit in view so you're never caught off guard, for a one-time $5.99.

apps.name: MailVault
apps.tagline: Your email. Yours to keep.
apps.description:
MailVault is a fast, private email app for macOS, Windows and Linux that keeps your mail on your computer. It works with Gmail, Outlook.com, Microsoft 365, iCloud, Yahoo and any IMAP account, and there's no account with MailVault and your mail never passes through its servers. Back up and archive messages as plain .eml files that open in other mail apps, then delete them from the server to free up space while your local copy stays safe in the Vault. MailVault flags email trackers, warns you about dangerous links whose text doesn't match where they really go and verifies senders. You can build inboxes from your own views, add custom fields to messages, set up tagging rules, search everything locally and switch to a chat-style view. The full app and unlimited manual backups are free forever, while Premium adds verified archive-and-delete, scheduled automatic backups, Time Capsule snapshots and tracker stripping.

Key Features:

- Local Mail Vault: back up and archive email as plain .eml files on your computer

- Archive and Delete: free up server space while every message stays in your vault

- Privacy Protection: tracker flagging, dangerous link warnings and sender verification

- Custom Views and Rules: build your own inboxes, fields and tagging rules

- Every Inbox: Gmail, Outlook, Microsoft 365, iCloud, Yahoo and any IMAP account

MailVault is a free, privacy-first email client that lets you truly own your mail, with Premium from €25 a year for automatic backups and Time Capsule snapshots.

apps.name: Downly
apps.tagline: Any video. Any quality. One click.
apps.description:
Downly is a Mac-native video downloader and one-click video toolkit from MacLabb. Paste a link from YouTube, X, Pinterest, Vimeo, Reddit and other sites, click Analyze, and choose from the available qualities up to 4K and 8K, HDR, audio-only MP3 or subtitles, then follow each download's live progress right in the app. Recipes let you save presets for your favourite folder, quality, format, subtitles and filename, so every download lands exactly the way you want with one click. Beyond downloading, Downly includes a full set of video tools: convert local videos to MP4, MOV, MKV or WebM, extract audio as MP3 or M4A, compress large files, change speed, remove or replace audio, trim and split, crop and resize, merge clips, add subtitles, clean up audio and make GIFs, all while keeping your original file intact. It runs on macOS 13 or later.

Key Features:

- Video Downloads: save videos from YouTube, X, Pinterest, Vimeo, Reddit and more in up to 8K

- Recipes: one-click presets for folder, quality, format, subtitles and filename

- Audio Extraction and Conversion: grab MP3 soundtracks or convert to MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM or M4A

- One-Click Video Tools: compress, trim, split, crop, resize, merge, change speed and add subtitles

- GIF Maker and Audio Cleanup: turn clips into GIFs and clean up audio while keeping originals intact

Downly combines a fast video downloader with a full set of one-click video tools for Mac, with a 2-day free trial and a launch price of $4.99 per year (normally $9.99).

apps.name: Hushtop
apps.tagline: Look up. It's handled.
apps.description:
Hushtop turns your MacBook's notch into a calm Dynamic Island for your agents, music, meetings and a little pet. It watches your Claude Code and Codex sessions, showing each project, branch and what it's doing right now, and the agent that needs you sits on top so you can Allow, Deny or answer right from the notch or open its terminal. It tracks your 5-hour and weekly limits and predicts when you'll run out at your current pace. Keep Awake holds off sleep even with the lid closed, step-away locks your Mac, and alerts can follow you to your iPhone. It also shows music with live lyrics, upcoming meetings, AirPods battery and timers, with a cat or hamster companion that reacts to your agents.

Key Features:

- Agent Control Center: see every Claude Code and Codex session and respond from the notch

- Usage Limits: track 5-hour and weekly limits with run-out predictions

- Keep Awake and Alerts: stay awake with the lid closed and get iPhone notifications

- Music with Live Lyrics: now playing controls right in the notch

- Meetings, AirPods and Timers: everyday info in one calm place

Hushtop is a notch command center built for AI-assisted developers, with a 7-day free trial and a one-time $9.99 price.

apps.name: Notch Design
apps.tagline: Give your notch a personality.
apps.description:
Notch Design is a native macOS app that customizes and extends your MacBook notch with beautiful shapes, live effects and useful little moments. Start with a silhouette from more than 25 lossless vector shapes, such as ink, hair, fire, moustache, bats, mountains and waves, tuned to meet the real notch without gaps. Then layer in live styles like music visualizers, battery and progress rings and a pull-cord lamp. Hover to open the expandable Notch Dock, which shows now playing, charging status, calendar and reminders, a focus timer, a file shelf with AirDrop, keep-awake controls and Claude and Codex usage limits. The app is free, with an optional one-time Pro upgrade that unlocks every silhouette and style.

Key Features:

- 25+ Notch Silhouettes: crisp vector shapes that fit the real notch

- Live Styles: music visualizers, battery and progress rings and more

- Expandable Notch Dock: music, battery, calendar, focus timer and file shelf

- Keep Awake and Agents: keep the screen on and track Claude and Codex usage

- Layered Effects: stack up to four live layers

Notch Design turns the MacBook notch into something fun and useful, free to download with a one-time Pro upgrade.

apps.name: Lily DB
apps.tagline: Your databases. Their happy place.
apps.description:
Lily DB is a fast, native macOS database client from Cortex Labs that brings nine engines under one roof: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB, DynamoDB, Trino and ClickHouse. Browse schemas and tables, write and run queries, and filter results with real operators without re-querying, freezing the first columns while the rest scroll. Its Trace activity monitor records the last minutes of everything running so you can scrub back to the moment things slowed down, and a Top tab ranks queries by total time. It's local-first, free and native, with a Windows version on the way.

Key Features:

- Nine Database Engines: Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, Redis, MongoDB and more

- Fast Query Editor: run queries and filter results without re-querying

- Trace Activity Monitor: record and scrub back through database activity

- Top Queries: rank slow queries by total time

- Local-First and Free: native macOS app with no account

Lily DB is a polished, free database client that handles almost every engine you work with on a Mac.

apps.name: Mint
apps.tagline: Smart Storage. For you and your agents.
apps.description:
Mint manages your Mac's storage with one framework built on each file's life cycle, from disk space to memory. It shows what's safe to clean, what's yours to decide and what needs to stay, and explains why before you act. Its optimization lets eligible duplicates share storage and makes supported idle files smaller in place, so you get space back while every file stays intact. A folder organizer sorts files by source, type, date or topic with a preview before anything moves, and a memory view shows which apps are holding RAM so you can release it. Auto Care runs your disk, folder and memory routines on a schedule, and Mint also understands AI agents, shrinking their redundant data and giving them local storage tools through a CLI and MCP that you approve.

Key Features:

- Know What to Clean: see safe, optional and must-keep files with explanations

- Space Without Deleting: duplicates share storage and idle files shrink in place

- Folder Organizer: sort by source, type, date or topic with a preview

- Memory and Auto Care: free up RAM and run routines on a schedule

- Agent-Ready: CLI and MCP tools so AI agents can manage storage with your approval

Mint is a modern Mac storage manager that frees space safely, free to start with an Unlimited upgrade for heavy use.

apps.name: Clipex
apps.tagline: Everything You Copy. Ready Whenever You Need It.
apps.description:
Clipex is a clipboard manager for Mac, iPhone and iPad that automatically saves everything you copy, including text, images, links and files, so nothing is lost to the next copy. Search your clipboard history by keyword to find something you copied days ago without digging through chats, webpages or documents. Your history syncs across all your Apple devices through your own iCloud account, and Clipex can extract text from screenshots and photos to make it searchable and reusable. It's built with privacy in mind: history is stored locally by default, nothing is uploaded or analysed, and you control which apps or content are excluded and when your history is cleared.

Key Features:

- Automatic History: saves text, images, links and files as you copy

- Fast Search: find past clips instantly by keyword

- iCloud Sync: access your clipboard on Mac, iPhone and iPad

- Text from Images: extract text from screenshots and photos

- Privacy Controls: local by default, with app exclusions and easy clearing

Clipex keeps everything you copy organized and synced across your Apple devices, free to download with optional in-app purchases.

apps.name: Copse
apps.tagline: Everything you copy. One keystroke away.
apps.description:
Copse is a private, native clipboard manager for macOS that keeps everything you copy searchable in an instant. Press Command-Shift-V in any app, type a few letters and press Return, and Copse pastes the item right where you are. It opens in about 15 milliseconds and searches up to 10,000 items per keystroke, recognising code with syntax labels, links, colours, screenshots, emails and terminal commands along with the app they came from. You can pin frequently used items, Quick Look anything with Shift-Space, and use Paste Stack to select several items and paste them in sequence. Everything stays on your Mac with no servers and no analytics.

Key Features:

- Instant Search: find any copied item in milliseconds with a single shortcut

- Paste Anywhere: paste straight into the app you're using

- Rich Content: code, links, colours, screenshots, emails and commands with context

- Paste Stack: select several items and paste them in order

- Pins and Quick Look: keep favourites handy and preview anything

Copse is a fast, private clipboard history for Mac that costs just $2.99 once.

apps.name: Murmur
apps.tagline: Talk. It types.
apps.description:
Murmur is a private AI dictation app for Mac. Hold the right Command key anywhere and speak, and polished text appears in any app with a text field, from Mail and Slack to ChatGPT, Xcode and Terminal. Speech recognition and AI run entirely on your Mac, even in Airplane Mode, so nothing you say leaves your device. Murmur removes fillers and applies corrections as you speak, adapts the tone to the app you're in, and lets you edit selected text by voice by holding Option and saying what to change. Snippets turn a phrase into saved text, Scratch That takes back the last dictation, and Paste Again sends text to the right window if it landed in the wrong one.

Key Features:

- Dictate Anywhere: hold right Command and polished text appears in any app

- On-Device AI: speech and AI run offline on your Mac

- Edit by Voice: select text, hold Option and say what to change

- Tone Per App: the right style for Slack, Mail, Messages or Notes

- Snippets and Scratch That: voice shortcuts and instant undo

Murmur is fast, private dictation for Mac that costs a one-time $19 instead of a cloud subscription.

apps.name: Widgetscape
apps.tagline: Desktop widgets, made for the Mac.
apps.description:
Widgetscape adds 31 live, native desktop widgets to macOS so your day, your music and your Mac are visible at a glance. Widgets cover calendar and agenda, weather, now playing, system stats, time, a Day Timeline dial along the edge of the screen and Token Pulse for AI usage. Everything lines up on a modular grid with eight sizes from Small to Huge, and each size has its own layout rather than a stretched copy, so a widget shows more as it grows. Drag a widget out of the library and your windows step aside so you can place it on a clear desktop, or right-click and choose Move Widgets to rearrange them along a soft dot grid. Widgets wear 23 palettes in light and dark, work across every display and Space, and keep all your data on your Mac with no accounts or ads.

Key Features:

- 31 Native Widgets: calendar, weather, music, system stats, Day Timeline, Token Pulse and more

- Modular Grid: eight sizes on one grid, each with its own layout

- Easy Placement: windows step aside while you place widgets, then snap them into position

- Personal Style: 23 colour palettes in light and dark

- Multi-Display Aware: choose displays and Spaces, with positions remembered per display

Widgetscape brings beautiful, live desktop widgets to the Mac, with 8 widgets free forever and a one-time €9.99 Pro upgrade.

apps.name: DevT Pro
apps.tagline: Every developer tool you need. In one offline app.
apps.description:
DevT Pro packs more than 120 offline developer tools into one app for macOS, Windows, iPadOS and Linux. Format JSON, decode JWTs, test regex, compare text, hash strings and convert data locally, without accounts or tracking. Tools are grouped into converters for JSON, CSV, YAML, XML and TOML, code generators that turn JSON and cURL commands into TypeScript, Swift, Python, Rust or Go, encoders and decoders for Base64, URLs, JWTs and HTML entities, plus cryptography, formatters and more. A command palette opens any tool in milliseconds, everything is keyboard-first, tabs let you work on several tasks at once, and every input is a real code editor with syntax highlighting, folding and find and replace.

Key Features:

- 120+ Offline Tools: converters, encoders, generators, formatters and cryptography

- Command Palette: jump to any tool instantly with a shortcut

- Keyboard-First: navigate and use every tool without the mouse

- Tabbed Workflow: run several tools side by side

- Pro Code Editor: syntax highlighting, code folding and find and replace in every field

DevT Pro replaces dozens of web utilities with one fast, private toolbox for a one-time $5.99.

apps.name: iloveframes
apps.tagline: The screen recorder that edits itself
apps.description:
iloveframes is a screen recorder for macOS and Windows that turns a single recording into a polished product walkthrough automatically. As you record, it watches where you click and type, then adds smooth auto-zooms that ease into exactly that spot and back out, along with a cinematic cursor. Every click and keystroke gets a tactile sound you can tune or turn off, and you can add music, a voice-over or your mic with noise suppression. Put your face in the video with a webcam bubble that shrinks during zooms so it never covers what you're showing, then set your screen on a beautiful background with real depth. A timeline editor lets you drag, stretch or add zooms at any time before exporting.

Key Features:

- Automatic Zooms: zooms land on clicks and typing with no keyframing

- Cinematic Cursor and Sounds: smooth cursor plus tunable click and keyboard sounds

- Webcam Bubble: circle, rounded or portrait shapes that shrink during zooms

- Beautiful Backgrounds: gallery-ready frames for every recording

- Timeline Editor: adjust zooms, music and voice-over before export

iloveframes makes demo videos look professionally edited with no editing work, available as a lifetime deal with a 24-hour free trial.

apps.name: BetterWispr
apps.tagline: Speak it messy. Send it clean.
apps.description:
BetterWispr is a free, open source dictation app for macOS. Hold Option-Space in any app and just talk, and BetterWispr drops the ums and false starts, spells names your way and writes in the style you set for each app, typing clean text right where your cursor is. Speech is transcribed on your Mac by built-in models from Apple Speech, Parakeet and Whisper, covering English, Japanese and 25 European languages, with no account and no cloud fallback, and models work offline after a one-time download. You can also choose your own Sarvam AI, Smallest AI or OpenAI-compatible API. Beyond dictation, it includes a meeting notetaker that turns conversations into notes and action items, plus insights into how you use it.

Key Features:

- Dictate Anywhere: hold a shortcut in any app and clean text appears at the cursor

- Smart Cleanup: removes fillers and false starts and spells names your way

- Per-App Styles: write in the right tone for each app

- Local Speech Models: Apple Speech, Parakeet and Whisper run offline on your Mac

- Meeting Notes: built-in notetaker with action items

BetterWispr is a private, open source alternative to paid dictation apps, completely free for macOS.

apps.name: Gleam Audio
apps.tagline: Studio-quality sound, without the studio
apps.description:
Gleam Audio is a simple app that removes background noise, evens out volume and cuts, splits and converts your recordings, all in one window. It's made for podcasts, voiceovers, audiobooks and videos, and runs offline on Mac, Windows and Linux. A deep learning model trained on human speech takes out fans, hum, traffic and room noise while keeping your voice clear and natural, and you can dial the strength back to keep a touch of the room. Pick where your audio is going, such as a podcast, audiobook, music streaming or broadcast, and Gleam levels the loudness to match that target and clears low rumble. You can see recordings as a waveform to cut and split them, convert formats, and your original files are never touched.

Key Features:

- One-Click Noise Removal: AI trained on speech removes fans, hum, traffic and room noise

- Loudness Leveling: match the volume targets for podcasts, audiobooks, streaming or broadcast

- Cut and Split: trim and split recordings visually on a waveform

- Format Conversion: convert audio files in the same window

- Offline and Non-Destructive: runs locally and never changes your original files

Gleam Audio gives creators clean, studio-quality sound in a few clicks, free for personal use with a pay-what-you-want license for commercial work.

apps.name: Mitosis
apps.tagline: Run separate copies of your Mac apps, side by side.
apps.description:
Mitosis is a free macOS app cloner that lets you run separate copies of your Mac apps side by side, such as Slack (Work) next to Slack, each with its own login, data and Dock icon. Pick an installed app, give your clone a clear name and open both at once, so you can stay signed in to different accounts at the same time. Each clone keeps its own settings, chats and caches, and a small badge on its Dock icon helps you tell them apart. The app shows each clone's disk, data, memory and CPU usage, and includes guides for popular apps like Slack, Signal, Discord, Claude and Codex. It installs with one Terminal command or Homebrew and requires macOS 15 on Apple silicon.

Key Features:

- App Cloning: run a real second copy of any Mac app

- Separate Logins: stay signed in to different accounts at once

- Separate Data: settings, chats and caches stay with each clone

- Badged Dock Icons: tell clones apart at a glance

- Free and Source-Available: a free alternative to paid app cloners

Mitosis makes juggling work and personal accounts easy by cloning your Mac apps, completely free.

apps.name: VibePause
apps.tagline: Mac break reminders. Built for developers.
apps.description:
VibePause is a macOS menu bar app that follows your coding sessions and guides short eye, posture and breathing breaks so long hours at the keyboard don't wear you down. It tracks time in your selected developer apps such as VS Code, Cursor, Xcode, Terminal, JetBrains IDEs, Zed, Claude and Codex, and pauses automatically when you step away. When it's time for a break, Pip, an optional desk companion that sits above your Dock, brings the reminder in a speech bubble and does the breathing, eye and stretch exercises right alongside you without opening a window. Pip mirrors your session, looking calm when you're fresh and tired after hours of work, and a Today page shows your breaks, focus timer and progress.

Key Features:

- Coding-Aware Tracking: follows sessions in VS Code, Cursor, Xcode, Terminal, Zed and more

- Guided Breaks: short eye, posture and breathing exercises

- Pip Companion: a friendly desk buddy that delivers reminders and takes breaks with you

- Smart Pausing: stops counting when you step away from your Mac

- Today and Progress: track breaks, focus sessions and daily habits

VibePause helps developers take healthier breaks without breaking flow, available on the Mac App Store for a one-time $14.99.

apps.name: Folio
apps.tagline: The notebook that studies with you.
apps.description:
Folio is a Mac app for study notes that puts every subject on a shelf of beautiful notebooks. Each notebook gets its own cover in cloth, leather, kraft or gloss, and pages feel like paper with lined, grid, dotted or plain styles where text always sits on the rule. You can underline in highlighter colours, type a slash for headings, checklists, code, post-its and arrows, and drop in photos as stickers with background removal. Folio also turns your notes and PDFs into flashcards that schedule themselves, writing the cards for you on-device, and Lio, a little star, quizzes you and answers questions about a page or a whole notebook with citations. Reminders bring pages back when it's time to review, and there's no account or subscription.

Key Features:

- Notebook Shelf: every subject gets its own customizable cover

- Paper-Like Pages: lined, grid, dotted or plain pages with highlighter underlines

- Auto Flashcards: turn notes and PDFs into self-scheduling flashcards on-device

- Lio Study Buddy: quizzes you and answers questions with citations, free and private

- PDF Markup and Reminders: annotate PDFs and get pages back when it's time to review

Folio makes studying on a Mac feel like a beautiful paper notebook with smart flashcards built in, for a one-time €5.

apps.name: LocalInbox
apps.tagline: Smart mail, sorted on your Mac.
apps.description:
LocalInbox is a native Mac email app for Gmail, iCloud and any IMAP account with AI that runs entirely on your Mac, so no cloud ever reads your mail. Built in Swift rather than as a web page in a window, it opens, scrolls and searches quickly across all your accounts in one unified inbox. On-device AI sorts incoming mail into categories like Primary, Updates, Promotions and Invoices to pay, writes one-line summaries of every message, flags threads that need a reply and surfaces sign-in codes you can copy instantly. You can also snooze, flag and search everything with Command-K, and create your own categories. There's no sign-up, and it's a one-time purchase with a money-back guarantee.

Key Features:

- On-Device AI: sorting, summaries and reply detection run privately on your Mac

- Smart Categories: Primary, Updates, Promotions, Invoices to pay and custom categories

- One-Line Summaries: see what every email is about at a glance

- Sign-In Code Detection: copy verification codes straight from the inbox

- Native and Fast: built in Swift with a unified inbox for Gmail, iCloud and IMAP

LocalInbox is a private, AI-powered Mac mail client where nothing leaves your device, with a 7-day free trial and a one-time license.

apps.name: Packtray
apps.tagline: Catch. Pack. Ask.
apps.description:
Packtray collects screenshots, copied text, files and notes into one clean handoff for any AI. While you work, every screenshot lands in the tray automatically and you can add copied errors with a shortcut, drop in files and write a note about what you need. One click turns everything into a numbered pack with a CONTEXT.md file, masks API keys and secrets on the way and shrinks big images. Then drag the pack into ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini or any AI chat, and your message is copied as it lands. It's fully keyboard driven, runs on Mac and Windows, and works entirely on your machine with no account, server or uploads.

Key Features:

- Automatic Capture: screenshots, copied errors, files and notes collect in one tray

- One-Click Packs: numbered context packs with a CONTEXT.md summary

- Secret Masking: API keys and passwords are hidden before sharing

- Works with Any AI: ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, Cursor, Gemini and more

- Local Only: no account, no server and no uploads

Packtray makes it effortless to give AI tools the full context of a bug or task, with a free plan and a one-time license.

apps.name: FileBridge
apps.tagline: The file manager that remembers your setups
apps.description:
FileBridge is a native macOS dual-pane file manager that connects your local folders and remote storage in one window, combining what you'd normally do in Finder and Cyberduck. Navigate two folders side by side, drag and drop files between your Mac and remote servers, and connect over SFTP and S3, with Google Drive coming soon. Its standout feature is Workspaces: save your whole setup, including panes, folders and open connections, and load it back later exactly as you left it, so you stop reopening the same folders and connections over and over. It also includes an image viewer you can browse with the arrow keys and folder search from the path bar. Nothing is synced to a server.

Key Features:

- Dual-Pane Browsing: navigate two folders, local or remote, side by side

- SFTP and S3: save connections and drag and drop files between local and remote

- Workspaces: save and restore panes, folders and connections in one click

- Image Viewer: browse images in a folder with the arrow keys

- Folder Search: find any folder by typing its name in the path bar

FileBridge is a fast, native file manager for people who juggle local and remote files, for a one-time $19.

apps.name: Homy
apps.tagline: Your Mac's files, finally beautiful.
apps.description:
Homy is a beautiful file browser for the Mac that shows your stuff instead of a list of filenames. Images, videos, music, documents, archives and apps each get their own shelf with big, clear thumbnails, and a Home dashboard shows totals for every category alongside your recent files. Finding things is as simple as typing what you mean: searches like "pdfs from last week over 5 MB" or "videos from my iPhone in August" become visible filter chips for type, date, size and source. Homy also reads the text inside your screenshots and photos using Apple's Vision framework, so you can search for a Wi-Fi password or tracking number and copy the text out. It remembers where every download came from, such as Gmail, Google Drive, ChatGPT, Slack or WhatsApp, finds exact duplicates and look-alike photos, and points out old installers, forgotten downloads, big old videos and unused apps to clear, always moving files to the Trash rather than deleting them. Everything stays on your Mac.

Key Features:

- Visual Library: big thumbnails and dedicated shelves for images, videos, music, documents, archives and apps

- Natural-Language Search: type what you mean and see it turned into type, date, size and source filters

- Text in Images: search and copy the words inside screenshots and photos, processed on-device

- Downloaded From: find files by where they came from, like Gmail, Google Drive, ChatGPT or Slack

- Duplicates and Clean Up: remove duplicates, look-alikes, old installers and forgotten downloads safely to the Trash

Homy turns Finder's file lists into a visual, searchable home for everything on your Mac, for a one-time early-bird price of $9 (normally $29).

apps.name: Zumbo
apps.tagline: Stop typing. Start talking.
apps.description:
Zumbo is an open source dictation app for macOS that uses local AI models to turn your speech into text in about a fifth of a second, with near perfect accuracy and complete privacy. Hold your shortcut, speak, and the words are typed wherever your cursor is, in any app, from Slack and Mail to Terminal, Xcode and Cursor, letting you write at around 150 words a minute instead of 40. Everything runs on your Mac and works offline, so nothing you say is sent to the cloud. You can teach it corrections and add vocabulary packs for your field, capture quick voice notes, use Meeting mode for timestamped transcripts, and browse everything in a searchable history with favourites. It requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.

Key Features:

- Instant Local Dictation: speech becomes text in about 0.2 seconds, entirely on your Mac

- Works Everywhere: types straight into any app wherever your cursor is

- Teach and Vocabulary Packs: correct words once and add domain-specific vocabulary

- Notes and Meeting Mode: capture voice notes and timestamped meeting transcripts

- Private and Open Source: offline, no cloud processing and fully open source code

Zumbo is fast, private, open source dictation for Apple silicon Macs, with a 3-day free trial and a one-time price of $15.

apps.name: CardLARP
apps.tagline: Browse. Drag. Flex.
apps.description:
CardLARP is a free Mac app that lets you restyle the cards in your Apple Wallet using thousands of community designs or your own artwork. Plug in your iPhone by cable or connect over Wi-Fi, and your real Wallet cards are mirrored on your Mac. From there you browse the built-in cardart.cc gallery of nearly 7,000 designs, search by issuer, colour, tag or vibe, and simply drag a design onto any card, where it lands on your phone within seconds. You can also drop in your own PNG or JPG, such as a photo, a logo or a black-metal look, and CardLARP fits it to the card. Every card keeps its own undo history so you can step back one change or rewind to the original look, and it only shows cards that can actually be restyled. No jailbreak and no account are needed.

Key Features:

- Huge Design Gallery: browse thousands of community card designs without leaving the app

- Drag and Drop: drop a design onto any Wallet card and it updates on your iPhone in seconds

- Bring Your Own Art: upload any PNG or JPG and CardLARP fits it to the card

- Instant Search: find designs by issuer, colour, tag or style

- Undo History: step back one change or rewind any card to its original look

CardLARP is a free, no-jailbreak way to give your Apple Wallet cards a fresh look straight from your Mac.

apps.name: CallLane
apps.tagline: Your music shouldn't go quiet when you join a call.
apps.description:
CallLane is a menu bar app for macOS that stops your music and videos from going quiet when you join a call. Normally, the moment a FaceTime, WhatsApp, Zoom or other call starts, macOS lowers every other sound by about 20 dB and there is no setting to turn it off. CallLane gives your call app its own audio device, so the ducking only applies to the call while Spotify, YouTube, games and everything else keep playing at full volume. It also fixes the other big call-audio problem: instead of letting your Mac switch to your AirPods' microphone and drop them to low-quality headset mode, it pins the input to your Mac's built-in or USB mic, so your headphones keep streaming at full 48 kHz quality. It works automatically with FaceTime, WhatsApp, Zoom, Meet, Slack, Teams and Discord, with no account and no kernel extension.

Key Features:

- Stops Call Ducking: music, videos and games stay at full volume during calls

- Full-Quality AirPods: keeps Bluetooth headphones in high-quality mode by using your Mac's mic

- Separate Call Audio: gives call apps their own audio device and volume

- Automatic: works with FaceTime, WhatsApp, Zoom, Meet, Slack, Teams and Discord

- Lightweight and Safe: menu bar app with no account and no kernel extension

CallLane fixes macOS call audio ducking and keeps your AirPods sounding great during calls, for a one-time $9 launch price (then $15).

apps.name: Halo
apps.tagline: Your messages. Your voice. A little Buddy. All in the notch.
apps.description:
Halo brings a Dynamic Island to your Mac, whether or not it has a notch. Notifications from Messages, Slack, Mail, Telegram and any other app arrive in the island right where you're already looking, and a click opens the conversation, with per-app control over what can appear. Hold Fn and talk to dictate anywhere, with your words landing wherever the cursor is, using Apple's free on-device speech recognition or your own Groq key for Whisper. Halo Buddy, a small face beside the notch, follows your cursor, naps when you step away and reflects your AI agents' status, showing when Claude Code or Codex is thinking, needs you or is done. Halo also shows which app is using your mic during calls, a redesigned Now Playing view with artwork and a scrubber, your upcoming events and external monitor brightness.

Key Features:

- Notifications in the Notch: banners from any app appear in the island, with per-app control

- Dictation Anywhere: hold Fn, talk and your words are typed wherever the cursor is

- Halo Buddy: a friendly face that follows your cursor and shows your AI agents' status

- Agent and Call Status: know when Claude Code or Codex needs you and which app has your mic

- Now Playing and Calendar: artwork, playback controls and your next events a hover away

Halo turns the top of any Mac screen into a smart Dynamic Island for notifications, dictation and more, for a one-time $9.99.

apps.name: Bytemail
apps.tagline: Fast, native email for your Mac.
apps.description:
Bytemail is a fast, native email app for macOS, built in Swift with SwiftUI rather than a web wrapper. It brings Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo and any IMAP account together in one clean unified inbox, with a colour ring on each avatar showing which account a message belongs to. Threads read like a conversation, with each message shown as a clean bubble and the reply field docked right underneath, and pressing Command-K searches every account and folder at once from an index stored on your Mac, so results are instant and work offline. Your mail goes straight from your provider to your Mac and never touches Bytemail's servers, and features like summaries, rewriting, sign-in code detection, phishing warnings, tracker blocking, one-click unsubscribe and undo send all run on-device.

Key Features:

- Unified Inbox: Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo and any IMAP server in one window

- Conversation Threads: clean message bubbles with the reply field docked right below

- Instant Search: Command-K searches every account, folder and attachment name from a local index

- Smart Safety: phishing and look-alike domain warnings, tracker blocking and one-click unsubscribe

- On-Device AI and Codes: private summaries and rewrites, plus sign-in codes copied straight from notifications

Bytemail is a private, native Mac email client for all your accounts, with a 7-day free trial and plans from $3.99/month, $39.90/year or a one-time $29 lifetime launch offer.

apps.name: DrawingPics
apps.tagline: Doodle on the left. Magic on the right.
apps.description:
DrawingPics is an offline AI art app for the Mac that turns your sketches into real images as you draw. Doodle on the left side of a whiteboard and watch a finished picture appear on the right, updating with every stroke, with no generate button and no waiting. Start from a stick figure or a rough line, use the result to redraw and refine, and keep iterating until it matches what you imagined. A built-in style picker switches between anime, photorealistic, oil painting and sci-fi looks, and controls for prompt strength and sketch adherence let you fine-tune the result. Version 2 is rebuilt natively with Core ML on Apple's Neural Engine, so it runs fast and quietly on M-series Macs, 100% offline with no accounts, telemetry or subscriptions.

Key Features:

- Real-Time Sketch to Image: every stroke instantly updates the generated picture

- Iterate Freely: refine rough sketches step by step until the image matches your idea

- Style Picker: switch between anime, photorealistic, oil painting and sci-fi looks

- Fine Controls: tune prompt strength and how closely the image follows your sketch

- Native and Offline: runs on Apple's Neural Engine with Core ML, nothing leaves your Mac

DrawingPics is a private, real-time sketch-to-image AI app for Apple silicon Macs, sold as a one-time $9.90 lifetime license.

apps.name: LumaDisk
apps.tagline: See every byte on your disk.
apps.description:
LumaDisk is a disk space analyzer for Mac and Windows that turns your filesystem into an interactive map so you can see exactly what's taking up space and reclaim it in seconds. View your whole drive as a sunburst or a treemap, drill into any folder and follow the breadcrumb back out, with the chart filling in while the scan is still running. A build-cache radar automatically finds node_modules, target, .next, DerivedData and other folders that rebuild themselves, while the duplicates and unused tabs surface copies and large files nobody has opened in months. It also maps iCloud Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox, including cloud-only files. Built in Rust with GPUI, it runs natively on Apple silicon, never uploads your scans and needs no account.

Key Features:

- Sunburst and Treemap Views: see your whole drive as one interactive map and drill into any folder

- Build-Cache Radar: auto-detects node_modules, target, DerivedData and other rebuildable caches

- Duplicates and Unused Files: find duplicate groups and large files untouched for months

- Cloud Drive Support: maps iCloud Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox, including cloud-only files

- Native and Private: built with Rust and GPUI, no telemetry and no account required

LumaDisk makes finding and freeing disk space fast and visual, with free scanning forever and a one-time $6.89 unlock for the cleanup tools.

apps.name: Context Dock
apps.tagline: Switch your macOS Dock by context, instantly.
apps.description:
Context Dock is a lightweight menu bar utility that lets you create profiles and give each one its own Dock. Set up contexts like Work, Study, Editing or Travel, choose the apps and folders that belong in each and their order, then switch between them in one click from the menu bar or with a keyboard shortcut. Your Dock always shows only what matters for the task at hand, so there is less clutter and less friction when you change gears. It needs only basic permission to manage the Dock, uses no background processes, collects no telemetry, works completely offline after activation, and runs on macOS 12 or later on both Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

Key Features:

- Unlimited Profiles: build Docks for Work, Study, Editing, Travel or any context you like

- One-Click Switching: change your entire Dock instantly from the menu bar or a keyboard shortcut

- Profile-Specific Apps and Folders: each profile keeps its own apps, folders and order

- Lightweight Menu Bar Utility: no background processes and almost no resource use

- Privacy-Friendly: no telemetry, no tracking and fully offline once activated

Context Dock keeps your Dock focused on what you're doing right now, with a one-time $9.99 lifetime license for up to two Macs.

apps.name: Sidelet
apps.tagline: Your Mac. Fully in your hands.
apps.description:
Sidelet is an all-in-one menu bar app that puts 27 everyday Mac tools behind a single icon. Instead of collecting separate little helpers to keep your Mac awake, manage the clipboard, snap windows, take screenshots and switch audio, you click one icon and everything is a tap away, with one look and one place to set it all up. Keep Awake can run for an hour, until a set time or until an app quits or a download finishes, while Battery and System show charge, health, CPU, memory, temperatures and exactly where every watt goes. Windows snap into halves and quarters by dragging or with shortcuts, the clipboard history pastes at the pointer, and Sound lets you switch outputs, mute the mic from anywhere and give each app its own volume. A radial menu, a launcher, a natural-language to-do list, dictation and more round out the toolkit.

Key Features:

- 27 Tools in One Icon: keep awake, clipboard, windows, capture, sound, camera, launcher and more in your menu bar

- Smart Keep Awake: stay awake for a set time, until an app quits or until a download finishes

- Window Snapping: drag to edges and corners or use shortcuts for halves, quarters and full screen

- Power and System Insights: battery health, charging and a live breakdown of where every watt goes

- Per-App Sound Control: switch outputs, mute the mic from anywhere and set each app's volume

Sidelet replaces a drawer full of small utilities with one tidy menu bar app, launching October 16 with a yearly subscription and 30 days free for early waitlist sign-ups.

apps.name: Voila
apps.tagline: Paste a link and... Voilà, you have a chart.
apps.description:
Voilà Charts is a Mac app that turns data into a finished chart the moment you paste it. You bring the numbers in whatever form you have them: a link to a web page with a table, a screenshot of a table, cells copied from a spreadsheet, or a CSV or text file. Voilà reads the table and makes the choices for you, picking bars or a line, the right column, how many rows to show and where the labels go, so you start from a polished chart instead of a blank canvas. Click any bar, line, label or axis to change only what makes sense for it, add a second link to compare two sources on one chart, and apply your own logo and brand palette so every chart comes out in your colors. One click copies the chart exactly as you see it for a post, a chat or a slide.

Key Features:

- Paste Anything: links, screenshots of tables, copied cells, CSV or text files

- Smart Defaults: automatically picks the chart type, columns, row count and label placement

- Click-to-Edit: change colors, units, labels or switch between bars and lines with a click

- Compare Sources: add a second link and both datasets land on one chart, aligned automatically

- Your Brand: add your logo and pick palettes built on your brand color for every new chart

Voilà Charts turns any table into a clean, shareable chart in one paste, with 10 free charts to try and a one-time $14.99 launch price.

apps.name: ChainYourMac
apps.tagline: The scrolling window manager for macOS.
apps.description:
ChainYourMac is a native scrolling window manager for macOS, inspired by PaperWM and niri on Linux. Instead of splitting your screen into ever-smaller tiles, it places every window side by side on one endless horizontal strip that runs past the edges of your display, so nothing overlaps, nothing hides behind anything else, and opening another app never shrinks the rest. New windows slot in right next to the one you're using, and the strip follows your focus as you move with the keyboard or swipe sideways on your trackpad. You can cycle window widths, go full width, center a window, stack windows or group them as tabs. It's notarized by Apple, needs only the Accessibility permission, doesn't require disabling SIP, and runs on macOS 13 or later on Apple silicon.

Key Features:

- Scrolling Strip Layout: every window gets its own column on an endless horizontal strip

- Nothing Shrinks: new windows open beside the focused one while the rest keep their size

- Trackpad and Keyboard Navigation: swipe sideways or use shortcuts to move focus and windows

- Flexible Sizing: cycle widths, go full width, center, stack or tab windows

- Safe and Native: notarized, no SIP changes, only the Accessibility permission needed

ChainYourMac brings PaperWM-style scrolling tiling to macOS, sold as a one-time $19.99 lifetime license.

apps.name: Kippy
apps.tagline: Everything on your mind, one shortcut away.
apps.description:
Kippy is a capture app for the Mac that lets you type it, say it or snap it without leaving the app you're in, then brings it back when it matters. A tiny panel opens over any app with a shortcut: type a note, paste a link, hold a key and talk, or snap part of the screen. Kippy sorts what you capture automatically, so "Call Mira tomorrow at 10" becomes an event and "Buy milk" becomes a task, and it remembers the app and site you were in. Notes wait as tabs on the edge of your screen and pop up in the app or website they belong to. It can also record and transcribe meetings and turn action items into linked tasks, annotate screenshots like a whiteboard, read you a morning brief, and turn notes into shareable cards, all running on your Mac with no account.

Key Features:

- Instant Capture: type, paste, speak or snap the screen from a tiny panel over any app

- Automatic Sorting: turns captures into events, tasks and reminders on its own

- Context-Aware Notes: pin notes to apps or websites so they pop up when you return there

- Meeting Notes to Tasks: record, transcribe and turn action items into linked tasks

- Snap and Annotate: screenshot, draw arrows, boxes, highlights and blur, then share

Kippy is a fast, private capture tool that makes sure your thoughts resurface at the right moment, launching with a 7-day free trial and a one-time early-bird price of $9.99 (then $14.99).

apps.name: DisplayPilot
apps.tagline: Plug in. Every display lands where you left it.
apps.description:
DisplayPilot is a menu bar app for macOS that remembers how your displays are arranged at home, at the office and on the road, and puts everything back the moment you plug in. Docks, KVM switches and sleep/wake cycles often scramble the arrangement macOS remembers, so DisplayPilot saves each setup as a profile, including positions, resolutions, refresh rates and the primary display. When that set of displays reconnects, it recognizes the setup and restores it, automatically with Pro or in one click. After every restore it reads the result back and reports anything macOS didn't apply, and it can even tell two identical monitors apart by where they sit in your saved arrangement. No account or subscription is needed.

Key Features:

- Display Profiles: save arrangements for home, office, travel and any other desk you use

- Auto-Restore: recognizes a connected setup and puts it back automatically with Pro

- Full Setup Memory: positions, resolutions, refresh rates and the primary display

- Verified Restores: checks each setting afterwards and reports anything macOS didn't apply

- Identical Monitor Matching: tells same-model monitors apart by their saved position

DisplayPilot ends the daily display-rearranging routine, free for one setup with a one-time $9.99 Pro upgrade for unlimited profiles and auto-restore.

apps.name: Sipbreak
apps.tagline: Drink water. Stand up. Keep your focus.
apps.description:
Sipbreak is a menu bar app that gently reminds you to drink water, move and rest your eyes without breaking your flow. Reminders appear as a floating card, in the notch or as a notification, and they never take keyboard focus, so whatever you're typing keeps going. Sipbreak automatically holds reminders while you're on a call, sharing your screen, in a calendar meeting, away from your desk or with your Mac locked, then restarts the clock fresh when you're back. Pick a Gentle, Balanced or Active pace, add your own reminders, and answer each one in a click with Done, Snooze, When free or Skip. A history view shows your streaks over 7, 30 and 90 days.

Key Features:

- Focus-Friendly Reminders: floating card, notch or notification, never stealing keyboard focus

- Smart Pausing: holds reminders during calls, screen sharing, meetings, idle time and lock

- Flexible Pace: Gentle, Balanced and Active presets plus your own custom reminders

- One-Click Responses: Done, Snooze, When free or Skip right from the reminder

- History Tracking: see your water, movement and eye-rest habits over 7, 30 and 90 days

Sipbreak keeps you hydrated and moving without interrupting your work, for a one-time $1.99 launch price (then $14.99).

apps.name: Zeptap
apps.tagline: Give your agents control of your iPhone.
apps.description:
Zeptap is a Mac app that lets AI agents like Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex and Cursor see, tap and type on your real iPhone. It runs a local MCP server on your Mac, so your agent can open apps, read the screen, tap, swipe and type exactly the way you would, with every step returning a screenshot so you can follow along. That means agents can handle real tasks inside iPhone apps: posting to Instagram, replying on LinkedIn, booking a ride, researching inside apps or testing your own app on a real device. Nothing is installed on the phone, nothing goes through the cloud, and you can connect several iPhones and watch them all from one window.

Key Features:

- Agent Control of a Real iPhone: open apps, read the screen, tap, swipe and type

- Works With Your Agent: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients

- Local MCP Server: runs entirely on your Mac with no cloud and nothing to install on the phone

- Step-by-Step Screenshots: every tool call returns a screenshot so you can see what happened

- Multiple iPhones: connect and watch several devices from one window with Lifetime Plus

Zeptap gives AI agents hands on a real iPhone through a local MCP server, with a free trial and monthly or one-time lifetime plans.

apps.name: Markdific
apps.tagline: Markdown Viewer and Editor for Mac, Windows and Linux
apps.description:
Markdific is a Markdown viewer and editor for opening, editing and exporting .md files. You can edit visually in WYSIWYG mode with no Markdown syntax in the way, or work with the raw source and see a live preview beside it in split view. It renders everything properly, including Mermaid diagrams, tables, code, task lists, alerts, charts, front matter, images, LaTeX math and footnotes. Themes and fonts make long reading comfortable, and finished documents can be exported to PDF, Word or self-contained HTML with their diagrams and tables included. On the Mac it also adds Quick Look support, so you can press Space on a .md file in Finder to see it formatted.

Key Features:

- Three Editing Modes: WYSIWYG live editor, Markdown source and split view with live preview

- Full Rendering: Mermaid diagrams, tables, code, task lists, alerts, charts, math and front matter

- Export Anywhere: PDF (Letter, A4 or Legal), editable Word .docx, HTML or Markdown

- Themes and Fonts: Original, Dark, Creammy, Solarized and High Contrast with a choice of typefaces

- Quick Look and Tabs: preview .md files from Finder and keep several documents open with an outline

Markdific is a polished Markdown reader and editor that renders, edits and exports .md files for a one-time price, with a 14-day free trial.

apps.name: Trailback
apps.tagline: Can't find it? Just describe it.
apps.description:
Trailback finds the file, web page or screenshot you lost, even when you've forgotten its name, where you saved it or which browser it was in. It quietly remembers what you open and see on your computer, so describing what you remember is enough. Ask for "that hotel with the pool" and it brings back the page you closed days ago, the screenshot of the price table and the PDF booking confirmation, all grouped by what you were working on. It reads the words inside screenshots and documents, tracks which website each download came from, and understands what you mean rather than just matching exact words. It works 100% offline, never records private windows, and runs on Mac and Windows.

Key Features:

- Find Closed Pages: bring back any page you visited, even after clearing your history, in any browser

- Screenshot Search: find screenshots by any word that appears inside them

- Document Search: locate PDFs, Word files and notes by what's inside them

- Download Origins: see which website every download came from

- Fully Offline: nothing leaves your computer and private windows are never recorded

Trailback is an offline, describe-it-to-find-it search tool that recovers lost pages, screenshots and files, available for a one-time $5 launch price (normally $29).

apps.name: Pungo
apps.tagline: Custom cursors. Clearer presentations.
apps.description:
Pungo is a Mac app that adds personality to the things you do a hundred times a day. It gives you original custom cursor packs that you can browse, preview and apply in seconds, choosing your size and keeping only the cursors you love while the rest stay at the macOS default. For presentations, Pungo lets you point, draw and zoom over any Mac app with a floating toolbar, freehand drawing, arrows, shapes, numbered steps and spotlight effects, all switchable with keyboard shortcuts. It also includes Keep Awake, which stops your Mac sleeping on a timer or until your AI task finishes, and a helper that restores your cursor after a restart.

Key Features:

- Custom Cursor Packs: original pointer, link and grab cursors you can preview and apply instantly

- Pick and Choose: change only the cursors you like and keep the macOS defaults for the rest

- Presentation Tools: point, draw, zoom and highlight over any app with a floating toolbar

- Annotations: freehand drawing, arrows, shapes and numbered steps with keyboard shortcuts

- Keep Awake: keep your Mac awake on a timer or until an AI task finishes

Pungo combines playful custom cursors, on-screen presentation tools and Keep Awake in one Mac app for a single €7.99 license.

apps.name: RollFerry
apps.tagline: Get your photos off your phone and onto your Mac.
apps.description:
RollFerry is a Mac app that copies photos and videos off an Android phone over USB, filling the gap left by the discontinued Android File Transfer. Plug in your phone and RollFerry reads what's on it in seconds, showing only the photos and videos that aren't on your Mac yet, grouped by month. Pick a month, a range or everything and it crosses each file over, checking every copy byte for byte with SHA-256. If you unplug halfway it picks up where it stopped, and it only offers to free space on your phone for files it has verified on your Mac. It never uploads anything, needs no account, works offline and runs in Apple's sandbox.

Key Features:

- Only What's New: see photos and videos not yet on your Mac, organized by month

- Verified Copies: every file is checked with SHA-256 before it counts as transferred

- Resumable Transfers: unplug mid-way and it continues exactly where it stopped

- Safe Space Freeing: deletes from the phone only files proven to be on your Mac, and only when you ask

- Fully Private: no uploads, no account, works offline and runs in Apple's sandbox

RollFerry is a simple, verified way to move photos and videos from an Android phone to a Mac, sold as a one-time purchase with a free trial.

apps.name: Sorted
apps.tagline: Drop files. Sorted does the rest.
apps.description:
Sorted is an AI file organizer that turns scattered files into a private local library that keeps organizing itself. It watches folders like Downloads for new arrivals, extracts content from PDFs, scans, images and Office documents, adds useful tags and proposes a clear destination only when a separate folder actually helps. It finds exact and visual duplicates, applies custom rules that always win, and lets you search by meaning rather than filename. You can ask follow-up questions about your documents and get answers with citations to the exact page, and at tax time export a reviewable Tax Pack with the source documents your accountant needs. All of it runs locally on your Mac.

Key Features:

- Watched Folders: new files are read, tagged and routed automatically as they arrive

- Duplicate Review: find exact and visually similar duplicates and clean them up safely

- Meaning-Based Search: find documents by what they contain, not what they were named

- Cited Answers: ask questions about your files and open the cited page to verify

- Custom Rules and Tax Pack: route and tag files your way and export organized tax records

Sorted is a local, AI-powered file organizer for Mac that tidies, deduplicates and lets you search and question your documents for a one-time $9.99.

apps.name: Hushmark
apps.tagline: Redact before AI. Keep private data out.
apps.description:
Hushmark is a privacy gate for your AI workflow. Before you paste a document into an LLM or share it elsewhere, Hushmark finds and removes names, addresses, phone numbers, account numbers and other sensitive information from PDFs, Word documents, CSVs, text, HTML and images. Everything runs locally: no uploads, no accounts and no copies stored. Detection happens on your device, you review and adjust every match using templates and field groups, then export a secure copy with permanent redactions. The browser version is free to use, and the Mac app adds custom templates and batch redaction for a one-time purchase.

Key Features:

- Local Detection: sensitive fields are identified privately on your device, nothing is uploaded

- Review and Customize: pick a template, adjust field groups and inspect every match before exporting

- Permanent Redactions: export a secure copy that is safe to share with AI tools

- Wide Format Support: PDF, DOCX, CSV, TXT, HTML, PNG, JPG and WEBP

- Mac App Extras: custom reusable templates and batch redaction into a secure export folder

Hushmark strips personal data from your documents locally before they reach an AI tool, free in the browser with a $4.99 Mac app for power users.

apps.name: PeakPad
apps.tagline: 29 tools. One notch.
apps.description:
PeakPad turns the MacBook notch into a full control center packed with 29 tools, all one hover away. Instead of digging through menus, windows and browser tabs, you hover over the notch to see what's playing, grab something from your clipboard, drop files on a shelf, start a timer or check your calendar and reminders. It also goes further than most notch apps: it can show live sales and traffic from Stripe, Polar, Dodo, Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, Paddle, Shopify and Google Analytics, track your Claude Code and Codex token usage, and answer questions with Apple's on-device AI through Ask Peak, so nothing you type leaves your Mac. It runs on Apple silicon and Intel Macs with macOS Sonoma or later.

Key Features:

- Notch Control Center: now playing, calendar, reminders, app shortcuts, volume and brightness in one panel

- Ask Peak: private, on-device AI answers powered by Apple's models, right in the notch

- Revenue \u0026 Analytics: see sales from Stripe, Gumroad, Paddle, Shopify and more, plus Google Analytics traffic

- AI Usage Tracking: tokens, messages and streaks from Claude Code and Codex, read from local logs

- Productivity Tools: clipboard history, file shelf, timers, teleprompter and more, 29 tools in total

PeakPad is a one-time-purchase notch app that brings 29 tools, from media controls to revenue dashboards and private AI, into a single glance at the top of your Mac.

apps.name: Fling
apps.tagline: Instant Command Wheel for your Mac.
apps.description:
Fling is a macOS application that adds a radial command wheel at your cursor. Hold a shortcut, flick toward an action and release to launch apps, open links, snap windows or run shortcuts. This tool is designed for power users, designers, and developers who want their most-used actions at their fingertips.

Key Features:

- Opens a 15-slot command wheel at your cursor with a held shortcut.

- Launches apps, folders, URLs and deep links with a single flick.

- Snaps windows left, right or maximized instantly.

- Samples any screen pixel and copies HEX, RGB or HSL values.

- Triggers keyboard shortcuts and system actions visually, using little CPU and memory.

Fling is a macOS command wheel that puts your 15 most-used apps and actions at your cursor. Hold, flick and release to launch, snap windows or pick colors.

apps.name: NotchMomo
apps.tagline: A little friend. A happier Mac.
apps.description:
Momo is a macOS application that adds an animated companion to your MacBook notch, along with everyday productivity tools. It includes a focus timer, notes, clipboard history, a file shelf and quick links, all one hover away. This tool is designed for Mac users who want a friendly, playful notch app that also helps them focus and stay organized.

Key Features:

- Adds an animated notch companion with four looks, six colours and twelve expressions.

- Runs Pomodoro sessions, countdowns and a stopwatch with stretch and water reminders.

- Keeps named notes with search, pinning and local autosave.

- Includes a file shelf with an image converter and clipboard history.

- Works on Macs without a notch and keeps notes and clips on your Mac.

Momo is a macOS notch app with an animated companion and handy tools like a focus timer, notes, clipboard history and a file shelf. It makes your Mac feel friendlier while keeping everyday tools close.

apps.name: StitchSlide
apps.tagline: One canvas. Every swipe.
apps.description:
StitchSlide is a carousel maker for Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok that lets you design on one wide canvas and splits it into seamless slides. Photos, text and drawings can sit across slide edges so each swipe flows into the next. This tool is designed for creators, marketers, and small brands who want eye-catching carousels without complex design software.

Key Features:

- Designs the whole carousel on one canvas and cuts it into perfect slides.

- Lets photos and text span across slide edges for seamless swipes.

- Includes 16 photo layouts, 69 fonts and support for custom fonts.

- Supports drawing with a stylus and a brand kit for colors and logos.

- Exports slides as PNG, MP4 or PDF, with no account required.

StitchSlide is a free carousel maker that turns one wide canvas into seamless, swipeable slides for Instagram, LinkedIn and TikTok. It runs in your browser with no sign-up.

apps.name: GlidePage
apps.tagline: Any website. One smooth scrolling video.
apps.description:
GlidePage is a macOS application that records any website as a smooth 4K, 60 fps scrolling video inside a real device frame. Paste a link, pick a device and record, and GlidePage captures every frame for a perfectly smooth result. This tool is designed for founders, designers, and marketers who need polished website videos for launches and portfolios.

Key Features:

- Records any website, including localhost and staging sites, as a scrolling video.

- Exports in 4K at 60 fps, plus stills and transparent clips.

- Frames recordings in real iPhone, Pixel, iPad, MacBook and iMac devices.

- Offers six easing curves, adjustable speed and pauses.

- Captures live pages with animations and sticky headers, all on your Mac.

GlidePage is a macOS app that turns any website into a smooth 4K, 60 fps scrolling video in a real device frame. Paste a link, pick a device and record, with no editing needed.

apps.name: Orcylo
apps.tagline: Slow Mac? Claude limit? New sale? Know at a glance.
apps.description:
Orcylo is a macOS application that works as an Activity Monitor alternative in your menu bar. It groups hundreds of processes into the apps you recognize, keeps 30 days of history, and also shows AI coding limits and today's sales. This tool is designed for developers, founders, and power users who want to understand their Mac's performance at a glance.

Key Features:

- Groups about 700 processes into roughly 25 recognizable apps.

- Shows CPU, memory, GPU, disk, network and power as customizable menu bar readouts.

- Keeps 30 days of local history to see what slowed your Mac down.

- Tracks Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI limits with reset countdowns.

- Displays today's sales and site visitors alongside system stats.

Orcylo is a macOS menu bar app that replaces Activity Monitor with a clear, app-level view of CPU, memory, power and more. It also tracks AI coding limits and today's sales, with 30 days of local history.

apps.name: SearchOnMac
apps.tagline: Find anything on your Mac. Just describe it.
apps.description:
SearchOnMac is a macOS application that lets you search your Mac by describing what you remember. It finds files, apps, windows, browser tabs, mail, calendar events and clipboard history using local AI, without needing exact file names. This tool is designed for professionals and power users who struggle to find files with Spotlight.

Key Features:

- Searches by meaning, so phrases like "the pdf I downloaded this morning" find the right file.

- Finds documents, photos, apps, windows, tabs, Mail, Calendar and clipboard items in one search.

- Previews files and offers actions like open, reveal in Finder, copy path and share.

- Opens from anywhere with Option-Space and returns results in about a tenth of a second.

- Keeps all searches and AI ranking on your Mac.

SearchOnMac is a macOS search launcher that finds files, apps, windows and clipboard items from a plain description of what you remember. It uses local AI, so searches never leave your Mac.

apps.name: MacFold
apps.tagline: Close the lid. Watch your desktop bend.
apps.description:
MacFold is a macOS application that adds a folding animation to your MacBook as you close the lid. It reads the hinge angle and makes your desktop tilt, blur and settle like a foldable phone, all processed on your Mac. This tool is designed for MacBook owners who enjoy visual polish and fun desktop effects.

Key Features:

- Tilts, blurs and dims your live desktop as you lower the lid.

- Reads the MacBook's lid-angle sensor in real time.

- Renders windows, wallpaper and cursor together with ScreenCaptureKit and Metal.

- Lives in the menu bar, where you can pause or adjust the effect.

- Processes frames in memory on your Mac and never writes them to disk.

MacFold is a macOS application that makes your desktop tilt and blur as you close your MacBook's lid, like a foldable phone. It uses the hinge sensor and runs entirely on your Mac.

apps.name: Here
apps.tagline: Clipboard at cursor, without keyboard.
apps.description:
Here is a macOS application that brings your clipboard history to your cursor. Double right-click anywhere to open a small clipboard panel, then click an item to paste it, so your hand never has to leave the mouse. This tool is designed for designers, researchers, and anyone who works mouse-first and wants faster copy and paste.

Key Features:

- Opens clipboard history at your cursor with a double right-click.

- Pastes text, links and images with a single click.

- Shows a side hover preview before you paste.

- Filters clips by text, links or images.

- Works fully offline with no cloud, account or internet connection.

Here is a macOS clipboard extension that opens your clipboard history right at your cursor with a double right-click. It lets you paste text, links and images without touching the keyboard.

apps.name: Assist
apps.tagline: One notch. Everyday tools.
apps.description:
Assist is a macOS application that brings clipboard history, a file shelf, quick notes, focus timers and other modules into the MacBook notch. It also captures and annotates screenshots, including voice annotations transcribed on your Mac. This tool is designed for developers, founders, and productivity-focused Mac users who want everyday tools close at hand.

Key Features:

- Keeps clipboard history, a file shelf and a quick notes scratchpad in the notch.

- Runs Pomodoro, countdown and stopwatch timers with hydration reminders.

- Shows calendar events, reminders, music controls, system stats and screen time.

- Tracks revenue from Stripe, Polar or Dodo and Claude Code and Codex activity.

- Captures screenshots with quick edits and voice annotations transcribed locally.

Assist is a macOS application that packs clipboard history, a file shelf, notes, focus timers and other modules into the notch. It also captures screenshots with voice annotations, all for a one-time price.

apps.name: NotchMind
apps.tagline: Small notch. Big mind.
apps.description:
NotchMind is a macOS application that turns the MacBook notch into a home for music, files, clipboard history, timers and 28 everyday tools. It opens with a hover and shows what you need in the one spot your eyes already go. This tool is designed for Mac users and creators who want quick access to media controls and everyday utilities without switching apps.

Key Features:

- Controls music, switches speakers and shows what's playing from the notch.

- Holds dragged files in a tray and sends them via AirDrop.

- Shows download progress and converts files to PNG, JPEG, HEIC, PDF or ZIP in place.

- Offers timers, natural-language reminders and weather at a glance.
