- Includes a smart clipboard that recognizes colors, JSON and links and clears copied secrets.

NotchMind is a macOS application that turns the notch into a hub for music, files, clipboard history, timers and everyday tools. It keeps 28 utilities one hover away with a one-time purchase.

apps.name: Cuewake
apps.tagline: Leave it here. Find it when you're back.
apps.description:
Cuewake is a macOS application for leaving notes, checklists, links and files as cues to pick up later. It saves the context of what you were working on, such as the app, page or file, and helps you return to the right place when you come back. This tool is designed for busy professionals, makers, and students who juggle many tasks and want to resume work without losing their thread.

Key Features:

- Captures notes, checklists, links and files as cues from any app.

- Saves the app, window, page or file context so you can return to it.

- Organizes cues into Waiting, Later and Done, with search and filters by type.

- Works fully offline with no account or cloud.

- Uses a one-time license with lifetime updates.

Cuewake is a macOS application that lets you leave notes, checklists, links and files as cues and find them waiting when you come back. It saves your working context so you can pick up exactly where you left off.

apps.name: StepAway
apps.tagline: Stop Eye Strain. Protect Your Rest. Reclaim Your Flow.
apps.description:
StepAway is a macOS application that functions as a meeting-aware break timer for eye strain relief and better posture. It lives in the menu bar, reminds you to rest your eyes, blink and straighten up, and pauses automatically when you step away or join a call. This tool is designed for developers, designers, and anyone who spends long hours at a Mac and wants healthier work habits.

Key Features:

- Reminds you to take 20-20-20 eye breaks from a native menu bar timer.

- Nudges you to fix your posture with a Spine Align drop-down HUD.

- Adds gentle blink reminders to help prevent dry eyes.

- Pauses timers when you leave your desk and postpones breaks during Zoom or Slack calls.

- Includes guided eye and stretch exercises and a GitHub-style activity heatmap.

StepAway is a macOS break timer that reminds you to rest your eyes, blink and fix your posture. It pauses automatically during meetings and when you step away, so breaks never interrupt real work.

apps.name: StowLink
apps.tagline: Your links, neatly stowed.
apps.description:
StowLink is a macOS application that functions as a native bookmark manager. It lets you save, organize and search links with rich previews, nested folders and notes, and syncs with a free iPhone app. This tool is designed for developers, designers, and researchers who save lots of links and want them out of a cluttered bookmark bar.

Key Features:

- Imports bookmarks from Safari, Chrome, Firefox and Edge.

- Saves links from anywhere with a global shortcut, without opening the app.

- Organizes links in nested folders with rich previews, notes and playable videos.

- Searches by title, URL, domain or description, with a Command-K spotlight.

- Keeps your library local, with optional iCloud sync to the free iPhone app.

StowLink is a native macOS bookmark manager that saves, organizes and searches your links with rich previews and nested folders. It imports from all major browsers and syncs with a free iPhone app.

apps.name: MacDelta
apps.tagline: Change Log for Your Mac.
apps.description:
MacDelta is a macOS application that records what changes on your Mac in a local timeline. It tracks app installs and updates, growing folders, background items, network and Bluetooth connections, battery events and more. This tool is designed for power users, developers, and IT-minded Mac owners who want to understand what changed on their system and when.

Key Features:

- Records app installs, updates and removals with version numbers.

- Tracks folder size changes, such as Downloads or Developer growing.

- Logs new, changed or removed background items like LaunchAgents and LaunchDaemons.

- Records Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, drive, display, battery, sleep and thermal events.

- Saves snapshots for comparison and exports your change history, all stored locally.

MacDelta is a macOS application that keeps a local timeline of everything that changes on your Mac, from app updates and background items to folder sizes and connections. It helps you see exactly what changed and when.

apps.name: OmniNotch
apps.tagline: It's all in the notch.
apps.description:
OmniNotch is a macOS application that adds twenty tools to the MacBook notch. It brings an on-device AI assistant, media controls, clipboard history, a file shelf, revenue tracking and everyday utilities into one lightweight panel. This tool is designed for productivity-focused Mac users, founders, and creators who want quick access to common tools without opening extra apps.

Key Features:

- Includes Ask Omni, a private AI assistant powered by Apple's on-device models.

- Shows AI usage limits for Claude, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and Grok.

- Tracks today's revenue from Stripe, Shopify, Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, Dodo, Polar and Paddle.

- Offers clipboard history, a file shelf with AirDrop, a teleprompter, timers and a camera mirror.

- Adds calendar, reminders, to-dos, weather, stocks, emoji, unit converter, system stats and quick notes.

OmniNotch is a macOS application that packs twenty tools into the notch, from an on-device AI assistant to clipboard history, revenue tracking and a file shelf. It keeps everyday utilities one glance away with a one-time license.

apps.name: CTA
apps.tagline: A teleprompter under your notch.
apps.description:
CTA is a macOS application that functions as a teleprompter placed directly under the MacBook notch. It follows your voice as you read, scrolls your script automatically, and uses AI to help you write and polish it, while staying hidden from screen shares and recordings. This tool is designed for creators, presenters, and professionals who record videos or join calls and want to keep their eyes near the camera.

Key Features:

- Shows your script in a small panel under the notch, right below the camera.

- Follows your voice to highlight and scroll the current word, with speech recognized on your Mac.

- Stays hidden from Zoom, Meet, OBS and QuickTime during screen sharing and recording.

- Writes scripts from notes, Notion pages, Google Docs or files with AI.

- Rewrites scripts to be easier to say, fit a time limit, or follow your instructions.

CTA is a macOS teleprompter that sits under the notch and follows your voice as you read. It stays invisible on screen share and uses AI to write and polish your scripts.

apps.name: Vinaa
apps.tagline: All your AI chats in one Mac app.
apps.description:
Vinaa is a native Mac app for everyday AI use. It brings different models and conversations into one place, so you can ask questions, explore ideas, and return to chats without switching between apps.


- Cloud and local AI: Use models from different providers or run models locally on your Mac.

- Organized conversations: Keep related chats together in projects and folders.

- Search and navigation: Find past answers and move through long conversations.

- Tabs and windows: Keep several conversations open and move between them.

- Files and prompts: Work with attachments and save prompts you use often.

- Tools and services: Extend your chats with web search and MCP connections.

- Bring your history: Import existing conversations from ChatGPT and Claude.

- Local storage: Keep your conversations on your Mac, with optional private iCloud sync.

Vinaa uses your own API keys for cloud providers and supports Ollama and LM Studio for local models. Available for Intel and Apple silicon Macs running macOS 15 or later.
4:57 PM

apps.name: Drop Notch
apps.tagline: Your agents. Now in your notch.
apps.description:
Drop Notch is a macOS application that brings AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex into the MacBook notch. It shows live tool calls, lets you approve actions, and follows sessions started in your terminals, so you can manage agents without switching windows. This tool is designed for developers who run AI coding agents and want to monitor them while they keep working.

Key Features:

- Supports 16 coding agents, including Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot and Grok.

- Shows each tool call live and lets you approve or deny edits from the notch.

- Follows sessions started in terminals and lets you reply in place.

- Tracks token usage and cost by day, model and project.

- Includes music controls, a file tray, AirDrop, timers and system stats.

Drop Notch is a macOS application that puts Claude Code, Codex and 14 other coding agents in your MacBook notch. It lets you watch tool calls, approve actions and reply to agents without leaving what you are working on.

apps.name: Shotbase
apps.tagline: Capture, edit, organize, and share in one place.
apps.description:
Shotbase is a macOS application that functions as a screen capture workspace for screenshots, recordings and web pages. It combines capture, editing, AI-powered organization and sharing in one app, with AI that runs locally on your Mac. This tool is designed for designers, product teams, and creators who capture and share their screen often and want polished results without juggling multiple tools.

Key Features:

- Captures screenshots, screen recordings and full web pages at any breakpoint.

- Adds automatic zooms, 3D effects, backgrounds, frames and annotations in one editor.

- Names, tags and summarizes captures automatically using on-device AI.

- Keeps all captures in one searchable library.

- Creates share links and collects reactions and feedback in the app.

Shotbase is a macOS screen capture workspace for screenshots, recordings and web pages, with a built-in editor for annotations, zooms and 3D effects. It organizes captures with private on-device AI and makes sharing simple.

apps.name: InsurStaq AI
apps.tagline: See your code the way an attacker does.
apps.description:
InsurStaq AI is a macOS application that acts as a private AI security engineer for your codebase. It runs entirely on your Mac, traces real attack paths through your code, suggests fixes, and maps evidence to compliance frameworks. This tool is designed for developers, startups, and security teams who need security reviews without sending source code to the cloud.

Key Features:

- Traces attack paths from user input to dangerous code, not just file and line numbers.

- Explains each finding in plain English and suggests a patch to review.

- Rescans changed files to confirm a fix closes the vulnerability.

- Maps evidence to SOC 2, OWASP ASVS, PCI DSS and ISO 27001.

- Runs locally with 279 built-in rules and an offline vulnerability database.

InsurStaq AI is a macOS application that scans your codebase locally to find real attack paths, suggest fixes and verify them. It also maps findings to compliance standards, without your source code leaving your Mac.

apps.name: DockUI
apps.tagline: SwiftUI Templates & Visual Design Tools
apps.description:
DockUI is a macOS application for visually designing SwiftUI interfaces and exporting production-ready code. It combines a visual editor, a library of templates and components, and an AI design assistant. This tool is designed for iOS and macOS developers who want to prototype and build SwiftUI interfaces faster.

Key Features:

- Lets you add, resize and customize SwiftUI components visually.

- Generates clean SwiftUI code that pastes directly into Xcode.

- Includes a curated library of templates and components, updated weekly.

- Provides access to over 5,000 SF Symbols.

- Offers an AI assistant that generates and refines UI from prompts.

DockUI is a macOS application for visually designing SwiftUI interfaces and exporting ready-to-use code for Xcode. It includes templates, SF Symbols and an AI design assistant to speed up app development.

apps.name: EveryPaste
apps.tagline: One clipboard. However you work.
apps.description:
EveryPaste is a macOS application that functions as a private clipboard history manager. It saves everything you copy and brings it back instantly with Shift-Command-V, with all data kept on your Mac. This tool is designed for professionals, developers, and designers who copy and paste throughout the day and lose track of what they copied.

Key Features:

- Saves your full clipboard history, searchable by keyword, app or type.

- Reads text inside screenshots so images are searchable.

- Pastes copied items in sequence to fill forms quickly.

- Offers snippets with fill-in blanks and pinned boards for frequent items.

- Cleans links of trackers, strips formatting and converts colour formats as you paste.

EveryPaste is a macOS clipboard manager that saves everything you copy and brings it back with one shortcut. It adds searchable screenshot text, snippets, pinned boards and format cleanup, all stored privately on your Mac.

apps.name: Pastely
apps.tagline: Paste anything, exactly right.
apps.description:
Pastely is a macOS application that functions as an AI-powered smart clipboard. It reads what you copied and the app you are pasting into, then converts the content into the right format with a single hotkey. This tool is designed for professionals, developers, and anyone who regularly moves content between apps and spends time reformatting it.

Key Features:

- Formats pasted content based on the destination app and field.

- Turns messy tables, CSV or JSON into clean columns in Google Sheets.

- Rewrites emails or docs as natural chat messages for WhatsApp, iMessage or Slack.

- Fills entire online forms from a CV or saved details.

- Translates, rewrites or summarizes when you type an instruction before pasting.

Pastely is a macOS menu bar app that uses AI to convert copied content into the format the destination app needs. One hotkey turns data into spreadsheet columns, text into chat messages, or details into filled forms.

apps.name: ASO Engine
apps.tagline: Get more downloads. Rank higher.
apps.description:
ASO Engine is a macOS application for App Store keyword research and rank tracking. It helps developers find keywords worth targeting, analyze competing apps, and track rankings across countries in one workspace. This tool is designed for indie developers, app marketers, and studios who want to improve their App Store visibility.

Key Features:

- Researches App Store keywords with estimated popularity and difficulty.

- Highlights keyword opportunities based on your current rank.

- Explores competitor listings, visible keyword rankings and similar apps.

- Tracks keyword rankings over time and across countries.

- Requires no App Store account connection or sign-up.

ASO Engine is a macOS application for App Store keyword research, competitor analysis and rank tracking. It helps developers find better keywords and monitor their rankings across countries.

apps.name: Locul
apps.tagline: The second brain for your AI.
apps.description:
Locul is a macOS application that turns your notes, docs and dictations into a memory your AI tools can use. It indexes your existing content locally and keeps it up to date automatically as your decisions change. This tool is designed for founders and solo operators who rely on AI tools daily and want them to know their product, customers and decisions.

Key Features:

- Builds a memory from local files, Notion, Obsidian, dictations and LinkedIn posts.

- Updates outdated memories automatically and keeps a history of what changed.

- Creates entities for people, products, services and projects.

- Makes your memory available to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex.

- Runs locally, with an optional cloud AI mode that uses your own key.

Locul is a macOS application that turns your existing notes, docs and dictations into a self-updating memory for your AI tools. It keeps context current automatically, so AI answers reflect what is true today.

apps.name: Contextli
apps.tagline: Speak your way through work.
apps.description:
Contextli is a macOS application that functions as a context-aware voice dictation tool. It turns your speech into text formatted for the app you are using, such as a Slack message, an email or a bug report, and pastes it automatically. This tool is designed for professionals, founders, and teams who want to write faster without switching to a separate AI chat.

Key Features:

- Converts speech to text with a single Option-Space hotkey.

- Formats dictation automatically for Slack, email, bug reports and meeting notes.

- Works in any app you can type in, from Gmail and Notion to VS Code and Jira.

- Saves dictations as a searchable feed that AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT can read.

- Available on macOS, Windows, Linux and mobile.

Contextli is a macOS voice dictation app that formats your speech for whichever app you are typing in. It turns quick spoken notes into polished messages, emails and reports, and pastes them automatically.

apps.name: MakerNotch
apps.tagline: Your projects, at a glance, in the notch.
apps.description:
MakerNotch is a macOS application that shows the status of your software projects in the Mac's notch. It brings CI/CD, deployments, infrastructure, revenue and issues from multiple tools into one panel, without switching accounts. This tool is designed for indie makers, founders, and developers who manage several projects and services at once.

Key Features:

- Shows a single health verdict per project, such as all clear or CI failing.

- Connects to 11 tools including GitHub, GitLab, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages, Stripe, Polar, Sentry and Linear.

- Displays deployments, payments, errors, email deliverability and assigned issues.

- Includes a focus timer, notes, bookmarks and music controls.

- Stores read-only API keys in the macOS Keychain and works with or without a notch.

MakerNotch is a macOS application that puts CI/CD, deployments, revenue and issues for all your projects into the notch. It connects to tools like GitHub, Vercel and Stripe so you can check everything without switching accounts.

apps.name: Kiiwi
apps.tagline: Your keystrokes deserve a soundtrack.
apps.description:
Kiiwi is a macOS application that makes your Mac keyboard sound like a mechanical one. It plays real switch recordings from the menu bar with near-zero latency, so typing feels more satisfying on headphones or speakers. This tool is designed for writers, developers, and students who type for hours and enjoy the sound of a mechanical keyboard.

Key Features:

- Offers 38 real mechanical switch recordings across linear, tactile and clicky families.

- Places each key's sound spatially based on its position on the keyboard.

- Plays sounds with near-zero latency and randomised pitch for a natural feel.

- Runs from the menu bar with no window or Dock icon and 0% CPU between keystrokes.

- Detects key presses without reading what you type.

Kiiwi is a macOS menu bar app that makes your keyboard sound mechanical using 38 real switch recordings. It adds spatial, low-latency key sounds for a more satisfying typing experience, without reading what you type.

apps.name: ThoughtDrop
apps.tagline: A little more curious.
apps.description:
ThoughtDrop is a macOS application that delivers short ideas from books in a quiet menu-bar and notch reader. It offers concise insights on topics like habits, focus, creativity and money, with context and author attribution, so you can learn between tasks. This tool is designed for curious readers, students, and professionals who want small doses of learning without another feed.

Key Features:

- Delivers book ideas in the notch or menu bar on your own schedule.

- Covers topics such as habits, focus, design, money, creativity and careers.

- Includes context and book and author attribution for each idea.

- Lets you save or love ideas into collections to revisit.

- Offers a searchable library and topic selection with Pro.

ThoughtDrop is a macOS application that shows short, attributed ideas from books in your menu bar and notch. It helps you learn in small moments between tasks, with options to save ideas and explore their context.

apps.name: NotchOwl
apps.tagline: Keep your day a notch closer.
apps.description:
NotchOwl is a macOS application that puts tasks, focus timers, quick notes and calendar events in the Mac's notch. It keeps a lightweight daily planner one hover or Option-N away, with all data stored on your Mac. This tool is designed for students, makers, and professionals who want to plan and focus without digging through windows.

Key Features:

- Manages tasks and calendar events directly from the notch.

- Runs Pomodoro countdowns and a stopwatch that stay visible while you work.

- Includes a daily notepad that saves as you type and turns lines into tasks.

- Shows insights on completed tasks, focus time and daily activity.

- Opens with a hover or Option-N, and works on displays without a notch.

NotchOwl is a macOS application that brings tasks, focus timers, notes and calendar events into your Mac's notch. It keeps your daily plan one hover away, with all data stored locally.

apps.name: NotchPop
apps.tagline: A dynamic island for your Mac.
apps.description:
NotchPop is a macOS application that turns the MacBook notch into a Dynamic Island. It brings media controls, a file shelf, clipboard history, focus timers, calendar and live business metrics into the bar at the top of the screen, and works on Macs without a notch too. This tool is designed for founders, developers, and productivity-focused Mac users who want quick access to everyday tools.

Key Features:

- Shows now playing controls for Spotify, Apple Music and browser tabs.

- Provides a drop shelf for files and a searchable clipboard history.

- Runs Pomodoro timers, countdowns and hydration reminders.

- Displays revenue from Stripe, Polar and Dodo, plus live visitors from Google Analytics.

- Includes over 20 extensions, such as calendar, weather, local dev servers and AI usage stats.

NotchPop is a macOS application that turns the notch into a Dynamic Island for music, files, clipboard, calendar, focus timers and revenue stats. It keeps everyday tools one click away at the top of your screen, with or without a notch.

apps.name: Maccelerate
apps.tagline: Your Mac. Your Pace!
apps.description:
Maccelerate is a macOS application that makes switching Spaces, Cmd-Tab, Mission Control and App Exposé feel faster. It replaces slow system transitions with speeds and shortcuts you control, while keeping SIP enabled. This tool is designed for developers, multitaskers, and power users who switch between workspaces constantly and want less waiting.

Key Features:

- Speeds up switching between up to ten Spaces with custom shortcuts.

- Accelerates Cmd-Tab transitions to apps on other Spaces.

- Opens Mission Control and App Exposé faster via shortcuts or gestures.

- Offers three speed levels: Fast, Faster and Instant.

- Optionally replaces trackpad swipes with faster Space switching, with SIP left on.

Maccelerate is a macOS application that speeds up Space switching, Cmd-Tab, Mission Control and App Exposé transitions. It lets you choose your speed and shortcuts while keeping system protections enabled.

apps.name: Orbl
apps.tagline: Your Mac desktop, beautifully alive.
apps.description:
Orbl is a macOS application that turns your desktop wallpaper into a calm, living dashboard. It displays the time, weather, reminders, your Mac's vitals and live business metrics directly on the wallpaper, so the information is there whenever you glance at your screen. This tool is designed for founders, developers, and productivity-minded Mac users who want useful information at a glance without cluttering the menu bar.

Key Features:

- Shows clock, weather, air quality, reminders, countdowns and month/year progress on your wallpaper.

- Displays Mac vitals such as battery, CPU, memory, uptime and connected device batteries.

- Connects to Stripe, Lemon Squeezy, Gumroad, GitHub, Product Hunt and other services via read-only keys.

- Pulls values from any API by pasting a cURL command.

- Includes customizable colour themes and animated desktop pets.

Orbl is a macOS application that turns your wallpaper into a live dashboard showing time, weather, your Mac's vitals and business metrics. It connects to tools like Stripe and GitHub so key numbers stay visible at a glance, without adding menu bar clutter.

apps.name: Locus
apps.tagline: Your quiet place to think
apps.description:
Locus is a macOS application that functions as a private, block-based notes app. It offers blocks, backlinks, nested pages and templates in a native Swift app, with every note stored locally on your Mac instead of a cloud server. This tool is designed for writers, students, and professionals who want a Notion-style workspace without giving up privacy.

Key Features:

- Supports block-based writing with headings, to-dos, toggles, callouts, tables and code blocks.

- Links pages with @ mentions and backlinks, and supports nested pages and workspaces.

- Includes quick capture from the menu bar, daily notes, smart dates and templates.

- Imports from Notion, Obsidian and Apple Notes, and exports to Markdown, HTML or PDF.

- Keeps all notes on your Mac, with Touch ID app lock and version history.

Locus is a macOS application that provides a calm, block-based notes workspace with backlinks, nested pages and templates. All notes stay on your Mac with no account or cloud, making it a private alternative to tools like Notion.

apps.name: Pastily
apps.tagline: Your clipboard, but better.
apps.description:
Pastily is a macOS application that functions as a fast, private clipboard manager. It keeps a searchable history of everything you copy, including text, links, code, colours and images, and works completely offline. This tool is designed for developers, designers, and professionals who copy and paste constantly and want to stop losing important clips.

Key Features:

- Saves a searchable history of text, links, code, colours and images.

- Turns hex codes into live colour swatches and saves copied images to disk in one click.

- Auto-expires sensitive clips like passwords and API keys on a timer.

- Offers a paste queue and Notch Island, a live clipboard view in the MacBook notch.

- Runs fully offline with no cloud or telemetry, and is also available on Windows and Linux.

Pastily is a macOS application that keeps a searchable, offline history of everything you copy, from text and code to colours and images. It adds a paste queue, auto-expiring sensitive clips and a notch-based clipboard view to speed up everyday copy-paste work.

apps.name: Stoic
apps.tagline: Your Dolby Vision videos. Without the purple and green.
apps.description:
Stoic is a macOS application that functions as a native HDR video player for Apple silicon Macs. It plays Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HDR10 and MKV files with display-aware colour, brightness and frame timing, using far less CPU than common alternatives. This tool is designed for movie enthusiasts, video editors, and colourists who want HDR footage to look the way it was mastered.

Key Features:

- Plays Dolby Vision, HDR10+, HDR10 and HLG with accurate, display-aware colour.

- Supports MKV, MP4, MOV, WebM, M2TS, MXF, AV1, DTS-HD and ASS subtitles.

- Lets you save moments with timestamped notes, set A–B loops, and export clips.

- Saves HDR stills as HEIC, and locks private folders behind Touch ID.

- Runs natively on Apple silicon with Metal, with no account or telemetry.

Stoic is a macOS application that plays HDR and Dolby Vision videos with accurate, display-aware colour on Apple silicon Macs. It supports a wide range of formats and adds tools like saved moments, A–B loops and HDR stills, all in a lightweight, private native player.

apps.name: DiskMate
apps.tagline: Mac storage full? Get your space back.
apps.description:
DiskMate is a macOS application that functions as a disk space analyzer and cleaner. It shows what is taking up storage, separates files that are safe to clear from ones worth reviewing, and moves anything removed to the Trash so nothing disappears by surprise. This tool is designed for Mac users, developers, and creators who keep running out of storage and want a safe, private way to reclaim space.

Key Features:

- Scans home folders, any folder, or external drives and shows what is using space.

- Sorts results into "Safe to clear" caches and "Worth a look" personal files.

- Includes seven tools: Overview, Search, Space, Cleanup, Duplicates, Apps and Old files.

- Finds duplicates, app leftovers, old downloads, and developer caches like node_modules and Xcode data.

- Works fully offline with no account, moving cleaned items to the Trash instead of deleting them.

DiskMate is a macOS application that analyzes disk usage and safely frees up storage by clearing caches, duplicates, app leftovers and old files. It shows what is safe to remove and moves everything to the Trash, so nothing is deleted without your approval.

apps.name: Notch Buddy
apps.tagline: Your MacBook's Notch Can Do All This
apps.description:
Notch Buddy is a Mac app that turns your MacBook’s notch into a useful workspace for quick access to tools, stats, timers, files, and more. 

Keep revenue, analytics, clipboard, weather, screen time, and other tools just a hover away.

Key Features:

- View revenue and analytics without opening a dashboard.
- Track timers, screen time, system stats, and weather.
- Quickly access files, clipboard history, notes, and links.
- Use a built-in calendar, emoji picker, and scratchpad.
- Monitor Claude Code usage and activity.
- Customize the notch with different themes.
- Works on Macs with or without a notch.

One-time purchase with lifetime access and updates.

apps.name: IINA
apps.tagline: The modern media player for macOS
apps.description:
IINA is a free, open-source media player born to be a modern macOS application, from its framework to its user interface. 

It adopts the post-Yosemite design language of macOS and keeps pace with technologies like Force Touch, Touch Bar, and Picture-in-Picture, with a carefully crafted dark mode.

Powered by the open source mpv engine, IINA can play almost every media file, and with youtube-dl support and browser extensions it can play a variety of online streams and YouTube playlists in one click. 

Features include a music mode, mouse and trackpad gestures, thumbnail previews, online subtitles, system media control, a customizable UI, and a plugin system. Written in Swift and licensed under GPLv3, it has been translated into more than 20 languages and is in active development.

apps.name: Replay Software
apps.tagline: A tiny studio making delightful apps for Mac & iOS
apps.description:
Replay is a tiny studio, run by Alasdair Monk and Hector Simpson, that makes delightful apps for Mac and iOS. Their portfolio focuses on beautifully crafted, focused utilities.

Their apps include Sleeve 3, the ultimate music accessory for your Mac; Echo, a beautiful and pocketable SSH client; and Umbra, the missing app for Dark Mode. 

Each is designed with the polish and attention to detail that Mac and iOS users expect.

apps.name: Eagle
apps.tagline: Organizing design files has never been easier
apps.description:
Eagle is an asset manager tailored for designers, offering a better way to collect, search, and organize design files logically and all in one place. Even with tens of thousands of images and complex categories, everything stays smooth and efficient.

With AI built in, Eagle enables visual, semantic, and cross-source search, plus AI Actions that automate naming, tagging, and workflows. 

Collect via browser extension, drag-and-drop, or screenshots; organize with tags, folders, smart folders, ratings, and annotations; and browse smoothly with instant hover previews for images, GIFs, videos, audio, and fonts. It supports virtually all file formats, a rich plugin center, and cloud sync tools. Trusted by 400,000+ creatives, it's a one-time purchase with lifetime access and a 30-day free trial.

apps.name: CleanShot X
apps.tagline: Capture your Mac's screen like a pro
apps.description:
CleanShot X is the ultimate screenshot and screen recording app for Mac, packing over 50 features that make it feel like seven apps in one. It's a super-powerful replacement for the built-in macOS screenshot tool.

Highlights include a beloved annotation tool, scrolling capture for content that doesn't fit on screen, screen recording saved as video or optimized GIF, and a Quick Access overlay for instantly saving, copying, or dragging screenshots into other apps. 


It also offers text recognition (OCR), a background tool for social-ready images, pinned floating screenshots, and the ability to hide desktop icons. CleanShot Cloud adds one-click uploads with shareable links, custom domains, and team management. A completely native app rated 4.9 across 350+ reviews.

apps.name: Upscayl
apps.tagline: The #1 free and open source AI image upscaler
apps.description:
Upscayl is a free and open source AI image upscaler for Linux, macOS, and Windows that turns blurry, low-resolution photos into sharp, high-quality images. 

Using the power of AI, it enhances your images by up to 16x better resolution while preserving detail.

It offers different AI models for different needs, batch processing to upscale several images at once, double upscaling for extra quality, and vast customization options. 

The app is free forever with no subscription, and an optional Upscayl Cloud tier adds 10x faster processing, unlimited cloud storage, and cross-device access. Loved by creators, businesses, designers, artists, and developers alike.

apps.name: Hejour
apps.tagline: Notes that live in your days
apps.description:
Hejour is a simple daily notes app for Mac that helps you stay organized without distractions. Create notes, tasks, and reminders that connect across different days, making it easy to plan, track unfinished work, and capture ideas whenever inspiration strikes.

* Link notes across different days
* Manage tasks with recurring reminders
* Capture ideas from anywhere instantly
* Search all notes in seconds
* Private, keyboard-first design with code snippets

apps.name: Heed
apps.tagline: Full-screen reminders you actually notice, from your menu bar
apps.description: Heed is a lightweight Mac reminder app that helps you build healthy habits without breaking your focus. Create reminders using natural language, access them from the menu bar, and receive full-screen notifications that are easy to notice and act on.

apps.name: LocalChat
apps.tagline: Private AI workspace for your Mac, fully local and offline
apps.description:
LocalChat is a private AI chat app for Mac that lets you run powerful AI models directly on your device. 

Chat with over 300 AI models, including Llama, Mistral, Gemma, and DeepSeek, without an internet connection. Your conversations stay on your Mac, giving you complete privacy and control. No subscriptions, no accounts, and no cloud servers, just fast, secure AI that works offline whenever you need it.

Key Features

* Run 300+ AI models directly on your Mac.
* Works completely offline after setup.
* No account, login, or subscription required.
* Keep all chats and files private on your device.
* Optimized for Apple Silicon for fast performance.

apps.name: ProcessSpy
apps.tagline: Advanced Process Explorer for Mac
apps.description:
ProcessSpy is an advanced macOS process monitor that gives you deeper insights than Activity Monitor. View full command-line arguments, version information, environment variables, digital signatures, and real-time system activity with a fast, native Mac experience.

Built exclusively for macOS using native APIs and interface components, ProcessSpy delivers a fast, responsive experience on both Apple Silicon and Intel Macs. It supports macOS 14 and newer, including macOS Tahoe.

Whether you're troubleshooting applications, tracking system resources, managing multiple development environments, or investigating background processes, ProcessSpy gives you the detailed insights that macOS power users need.

Key Features

- Advanced process tree view with aggregate totals
- Full command-line and executable path visibility
- CPU, memory, and thread history tracking
- Multi-property and regex search
- Point-and-click process discovery
- JavaScript-based custom filters
- Remembers finished processes for later review
- Menu bar monitoring dashboard
- JSON and CSV export support

Perfect for developers, power users, and system administrators who need complete visibility into what's running on their Mac.

apps.name: Astro
apps.tagline: App Store Optimization that actually grows your app
apps.description:
Astro is a native Mac App Store Optimization (ASO) tool that helps iOS developers discover the keywords their users are actually searching for and grow app downloads up to 10x faster. 

Astro pulls popularity data directly from Apple Search Ads, calculates how difficult it is to rank in the top 10 for any keyword, and suggests new keywords based on your competitors' rankings — all from a clean, minimal interface designed for daily research. 

It tracks unlimited keywords and apps with a fixed annual subscription (no per-keyword fees), updates rankings every day across 60+ App Store countries, includes DeepL-powered translation, and surfaces new reviews from every store worldwide. 

90% of Astro users see an increase in App Store impressions within the first week of updating their metadata.

Core features

Unlimited keyword and app tracking with a flat annual price

Real popularity and difficulty data sourced from Apple Search Ads

Daily ranking updates, historical charts, and position-change tracking

Keyword suggestions plus competitor keyword extraction
60+ App Store country coverage with instant DeepL keyword translations

Worldwide review tracking and detailed rating analysis

Trusted by thousands of indie developers and teams behind HabitKit, Dumb Phone, and other top App Store apps — #1 Product of the Day on Product Hunt.

apps.name: Splonk
apps.tagline: Record vertical and screen videos with your iPhone camera on Mac
apps.description:
Splonk is a Mac and iOS app that turns your iPhone into a high-quality wireless camera for screen and vertical video recording. 

Fixing everything Apple's Continuity Camera gets wrong.

Splonk lets creators, app makers, and indie hackers record their Mac screen and iPhone camera simultaneously, perfectly synced in up to 4K, with hotkey auto-switching between sources during recording.

SplonkCam streams video directly to your Mac's drive instead of eating iPhone storage, supports manual focus, exposure, and white balance, and works with portrait mode, front or back camera, and multiple iPhones at once. 

A built-in timeline editor adds 18+ effects, 7 layout transitions, 13 caption styles, an audio FX chain, Smart Canvas exports to 11 platform formats, cursor visualization, and auto Ken Burns zoom, so your video is ready to post the moment you stop recording.

Core features

Dual-source recording — Mac screen + iPhone, webcam, or USB camera at the same time in 4K

SplonkCam wireless iPhone camera with full manual controls and direct-to-Mac saving

Timeline editor with J/K/L shortcuts, audio waveforms, and drag-and-drop scene reordering

13 caption styles (TikTok Bold, Karaoke, Neon Glow, Typewriter, Cinematic), text overlays, and animations

Audio FX chain with 3-band EQ, compressor, high-pass filter, and Podcast/Crisp Voice/Punchy presets

Smart Canvas exports one recording to 11 platform formats (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, App Store, more)

Cursor visualization, auto zoom \u0026 pan, blur regions, video backgrounds, and timeline markers

Join the app makers, course creators, and indie founders shipping App Store previews, demos, and tutorials with Splonk — one app, one take, done. 

One-time launch price of $39.99 includes Mac + iOS apps and 1 year of free updates

apps.name: Hand Mirror
apps.tagline: A quick camera check, right from the menu bar

apps.name: One Thing
apps.tagline: Put a single task or goal in your menu bar

• Drag and drop tasks from Reminders, Things, or any text source

• Native Swift/SwiftUI app — fast, free, and ad-free

Join thousands of focused makers using One Thing to achieve more by doing one thing at a time.

apps.name: LookAway
apps.tagline: Smart Screen Breaks, Blink & Posture Reminders for Mac
apps.description:
LookAway is a native Mac app that quietly takes care of your screen habits with smart screen breaks, posture nudges, and blink reminders that adapt to how you work.

• Smart break scheduling that adapts to recordings, calls, and focus apps
• Posture and blink reminders with gentle, non-intrusive notifications

apps.name: Granola

• AI enhancement that turns your raw notes into structured summaries

• Unlimited .local domains and wildcard subdomains on your local network
• Automatic HTTPS for every published domain — no certificate setup required
• Inspect, replay, and modify webhook traffic with a built-in inspector
• Framework-agnostic, tested with Next.js, Vite, Laravel, Nuxt, NestJS, and more

Join 2,500+ developers who replaced Ngrok with LocalCan to save 50+ hours of development per month.

apps.name: BoltAI
apps.tagline: The best AI client for Mac
apps.description:
BoltAI is a native, high-performance AI app for Mac that lets you instantly switch between 300+ AI models from a single workspace. It consolidates OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Mistral, xAI, Perplexity, and local models into one beautiful SwiftUI workspace.

Core features:
• Switch between 300+ models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and local LLMs

Helping people work smarter at Apple, Deloitte, Zapier, Cloudflare, and MIT.

apps.name: IdleMac
apps.tagline: Your Mac Knows When You're Slacking
apps.description:
IdleMac is a tiny macOS menu bar app that judges you when you step away from your work and screams at you to come back. It turns your Mac into your own personal accountability buddy with passive-aggressive sound personalities that activate the moment you go idle.

Core features:
• Custom idle timer from 10 seconds to 10 minutes
• 10 passive-aggressive voice personalities to keep you accountable
• Lives in the menu bar with no dock icon and zero distraction
• Lightweight, fully private, no internet or analytics required
• Auto-launches at login, works on macOS 13+ Intel and Apple Silicon

Join hundreds of remote workers, freelancers, students, and developers using IdleMac to reclaim hours of lost focus every week.

apps.name: Klack
apps.tagline: Satisfying sound with every keystroke
apps.description:
Klack is a native macOS menu bar app that makes your built-in or low-profile keyboard sound exactly like a premium mechanical keyboard. It simulates the full typing experience with high-fidelity, spatial audio sound effects.

Core features:
• High-fidelity mechanical keyboard sounds with spatial audio
• Distinct press and release sounds for true-to-life typing feel
• Randomized pitch variations on every keystroke for organic realism

apps.name: Paste

• Pinboards for organizing snippets and collaborating with teams

apps.name: Compresto
apps.tagline: Reclaim 50GB+ Without Quality Loss
apps.description:

• Reduce file sizes by up to 90%% while preserving quality
• Folder monitoring to auto-compress files added to watched directories

Join 11,000+ smart creators at Apple, Google, Meta, Vercel, and Coinbase using Compresto to reclaim storage and ship lighter assets.

apps.name: SlapMac
apps.tagline: Slap your MacBook. It screams back
apps.description:
SlapMac is a viral macOS menu bar app that gives your MacBook feelings: slap it and it screams back at you with volume proportional to your force. 

SlapMac turns your laptop into an interactive, expressive companion with 150+ sound clips across 9 voice packs and a brand new motion-triggered Anti-Theft mode. 

It hides quietly in the menu bar, reacts to USB plug-ins with USB Moaner mode, creaks when you open or close the lid, and even tracks your lifetime slap count. 

Featured on 500+ US radio stations and viral on Instagram, TikTok, and X.

Volume-sensitive slap detection with adjustable sensitivity and cooldown

150+ sound clips across 9 voice packs (woman, man, metal, goat, and more)

Lid Creak mode and USB Moaner trigger for plug/unplug reactions

Anti-Theft mode with motion-triggered alarm, Selfie of Shame, and Touch ID disarm

Menu bar only: no dock icon, slap counter, launch at login

apps.name: Pimosa
apps.tagline: Simple Video, Photo & Music Editing Tools in one app
apps.description:
Pimosa is a native Mac and Windows app that bundles powerful video, photo, audio, and PDF editing tools into a single lightweight package. 

Pimosa helps creators, designers, and everyday users convert, edit, compress, and enhance their media files quickly without juggling multiple apps or paying multiple subscriptions. 

It supports batch processing, runs fully offline for privacy, and includes built-in editors for trimming, cropping, merging, and adding subtitles. Pimosa replaces a cluttered toolbox of disposable utilities with one cohesive workspace.

Core features

Compress, convert, resize, merge, and trim videos with frame-by-frame precision

Extract audio, add music, and reverse or change the speed of any video

Compress, convert, resize, and edit images and GIFs in batch

Audio tools for converting, merging, trimming, waveform videos, and metadata editing

PDF compressor, splitter, merger, encrypter, and editor included

Join 1,000+ creators using Pimosa as their all-in-one media editor — no subscriptions, no limits, just powerful tools you own forever.

apps.name: Orbit
apps.tagline: A native workbench for the pi coding agent — chat, review, and commit in one window.
apps.description:
Orbit is a native desktop workbench for the pi coding agent — a chat-style GUI rendered entirely in Rust on GPUI, the GPU-accelerated UI framework Zed is built on. It speaks the pi CLI's RPC protocol directly over stdio: no browser, no webview, no Node.

Sessions you create in Orbit and in the terminal are the same sessions (~/.pi/agent/sessions/), managed by pi's own session manager.

apps.name: Panels

apps.description:
Panels is a beautifully designed comic reader and marketplace for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Panels supports the formats comic readers already own, including CBZ, CBR, PDF, and EPUB. Users can import comics from iCloud Drive, Files, local storage, web servers, OPDS catalogs, and supported cloud services. Libraries can be organized by series, creators, publishers, collections, reading status, and custom metadata.

The reading experience is designed to feel natural across every type of comic. Panels includes support for traditional page-by-page comics, manga with right-to-left reading, double-page spreads, vertical scrolling for webtoons and manhwa, panel-by-panel navigation, image enhancements, custom themes, bookmarks, reading progress synchronization, and offline reading.

Panels also includes the Panels Store, a DRM-free marketplace where readers can discover, purchase, own, and read comics directly within the app. Unlike closed platforms, comics purchased through Panels can be downloaded and kept by the reader. The store gives independent creators and publishers access to an established global audience while allowing them to retain control over their work.

Our goal is to make Panels the best place to read and discover digital comics, regardless of where those comics come from. Readers can bring their existing libraries, purchase new titles, and manage everything in one unified experience.

Panels is developed by a small independent team focused on thoughtful design, performance, privacy, and long-term ownership. User libraries remain under the user’s control, and core reading features are available for free. Optional premium features provide additional customization, cloud integrations, and advanced tools for readers who want more.

Panels is available on the App Store for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

apps.description:
## A better home for your newsletters.

Your inbox is where email arrives.

Letterboxx is where newsletters belong.

Letterboxx is a dedicated Mac app built specifically for reading email newsletters. It imports copies of newsletters from the email accounts and folders you choose, organizes them into a beautiful local library, and gives you a calm place to enjoy everything you signed up to read—but never quite found the time for because your inbox became a place for email triage.

If you've ever subscribed to thoughtful essays, morning digests, technology news, product updates, research, shopping deals, local news, or niche publications, Letterboxx gives them a home of their own. It's less like checking email and more like spending time in your own personal library of interests.

## What Letterboxx helps you do

- **Keep newsletters out of your inbox.** Connect supported email accounts, choose the folders Letterboxx should monitor, and build a dedicated newsletter library on your Mac.

- **Organize with Letterboxes.** Create custom collections for publishers, projects, hobbies, shopping, research, or anything else you follow.

- **Sort newsletters automatically.** Auto-Delivery rules organize newsletters based on sender, recipient, subject, content, and other message details.

- **Enjoy a cleaner reading experience.** Clean View reduces advertising, tracking, and unnecessary clutter so the writing takes center stage.

- **Highlight what matters.** Mark important passages with familiar highlighter colors and revisit them anytime.

- **Save things for later.** Unread status, favorites, reminders, highlights, quick filters, and search make it easy to pick up where you left off.

- **Manage subscriptions more easily.** When Letterboxx detects an unsubscribe link, it helps you get to the right place without hunting through a newsletter footer.

- **Feel at home on macOS.** Native controls, keyboard shortcuts, swipe actions, multiple themes, a familiar sidebar, and a focused reading pane make Letterboxx feel like a true Mac app.

## How it works

1. Connect one or more supported email accounts.
2. Choose the folders Letterboxx should import from.
3. Letterboxx creates a local library containing copies of your newsletters.
4. Read, organize, highlight, favorite, search, and revisit them whenever you like.
5. Continue using your favorite email app for everyday email.

## Built differently

Letterboxx is **not** a general-purpose email client.

There is no composing, replying, forwarding, or inbox-zero pressure. It exists for one purpose: giving your newsletters a place where they can finally be enjoyed.

It works especially well with a dedicated newsletter email address, but you can just as easily connect an existing account and choose only the folders you want Letterboxx to use.

## Private by design

Your newsletter library lives on **your Mac**.

Letterboxx doesn't include ads, social features, public user content, or data selling. During normal imports, your original messages remain safely in your connected mail account while Letterboxx builds a fast, local library for reading.

**Give your newsletters the home they've always deserved.**

apps.description:
Mongon is a native database client for developers who live on Apple hardware. MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and Redis side by side in one app — written in 100% Swift, so it launches instantly, stays light on memory, and feels at home on macOS and iOS. No Electron, no browser runtime.

It's built for the everyday loop: connect, find the document you need, follow its relations, fix it, move on.

## Query without friction

- Full visual query builder with autocomplete — or type raw filters directly
- 35+ date macros: write #today or #last7days instead of hand-crafting ISODate() ranges
- Click any ObjectId to jump straight to the referenced document — Mongon learns which collection it belongs to
- Table, card, and JSON view modes; switch per collection
- ⌘P command palette jumps to any collection, tab, or saved query

## The full toolkit

- 14-stage visual aggregation pipeline builder with stage-by-stage previews
- Create, edit, and delete documents with a schema-aware editor
- Copy an entire database to the same server, a saved connection, or any connection string — collections stream concurrently, no mongodump
- Change streams: watch inserts, updates, and deletes live
- Export to JSON or CSV, import with automatic schema detection
- SQL editor with keyword autocomplete for PostgreSQL, built-in CLI for Redis

## Mac and iPhone, one purchase

Saved connections sync through your private iCloud database — no account to create, no servers of ours in between. Connect on your Mac and the connection is already on your iPhone. On-call at dinner? Your production database is in your pocket.

## Direct and private by design

Mongon connects straight from your device to your database with native drivers. TLS/SSL, SSH tunneling (password or key), and SCRAM authentication protect the connection; there is no proxy or relay, because we don't operate any servers. The app runs fully sandboxed and ships exclusively through the App Store.

## Free to start

The free plan covers everyday browsing and querying forever — 3 connections, the full query builder, relation navigation, and all date macros. Premium unlocks unlimited connections, aggregation, sync, export/import, change streams, and database copy with a one-time purchase or subscription. 14-day free trial, one purchase covers Mac and iPhone.

apps.name: Purge
apps.tagline: Reclaim disk space by clearing caches macOS leaves behind.
apps.description:
Purge is a free, open source cache cleaner for macOS. You open it, it scans, and it shows you how much space you can get back. One tap and it's gone.

Most cleaning tools ask you to become an expert first. Long lists of paths, warnings you can't evaluate, checkboxes you're not qualified to tick. Purge takes the opposite position: you shouldn't need to understand what a derived data folder is to get your disk space back.

## What it cleans

Developer caches like Xcode derived data and build artifacts, package manager caches, browser caches, app caches, and the general junk that accumulates in Library folders. 

## How it stays safe

- **Everything goes to the Trash.** Purge never deletes permanently. If it takes something you wanted, drag it back.
- **A strict allowlist governs what the app can touch.** Anything outside that list is invisible to Purge. It cannot be talked into scanning somewhere it shouldn't.
- **Two tiers only.** Safe to Clean and Check First. There's no third category of dangerous items to be careful around, because those items never appear in results at all.
- **Exclusions only subtract.** You can tell Purge to skip something, but you can't tell it to reach further.
- **No telemetry.** No analytics, no accounts, no network calls except checking for updates.


## Open source

The whole thing is on GitHub. Signed and notarized by Apple, distributed as a DMG or through Homebrew. If you want to know exactly what it does before you run it, you can read it.

Requires macOS 13 or later. Free, no upsell, no pro tier.

[github.com/jithin-sabu/purge-app](https://github.com/jithin-sabu/purge-app)

apps.description:
**ClickFit** is a native macOS menu bar window manager that makes arranging windows faster and more precise.

Hold a modifier key and drag from anywhere inside a window to move it, or right-drag to resize — no more hunting for tiny title bars, edges, or corners. Flick a window toward a screen edge to tile it, double-click to center or maximize, and let smart snapping align everything pixel-perfectly.

ClickFit is built for people who juggle many windows all day — developers, designers, writers, and anyone on a large display or multi-monitor setup who wants their workspace under control without lifting their hands off the mouse or trackpad.

## Key features

- **Move & resize from anywhere** — modifier + drag gestures, no precise targeting needed.
- **Smart snapping** — windows align to screen edges and neighboring windows as you drag.
- **Drag-to-tile zones** — halves, quarters, and full screen, with adaptive tiling around neighbors.
- **Tile size cycling** — press the same tile shortcut repeatedly to cycle between half, two-thirds, and one-third sizes.
- **Coupled resize** — resize side-by-side windows together, with a live preview. Works with native macOS resize handles too.
- **Layout Picker & custom layouts** — apply multi-window layouts from a radial picker, or draw your own.
- **Window Tabs** — group windows into a single tabbed frame with its own tab bar, traffic light controls, and drag-and-drop reordering.
- **Workspaces** — capture your entire window arrangement and restore it later with a hotkey, even after a restart.
- **Throw to Zone** — flick a window in any direction to send it to the matching zone or display.
- **Global hotkeys** — keyboard shortcuts for tiling, centering, maximizing, layouts, and moving windows between displays.
- **Trackpad gestures** — trigger Throw to Zone and the Layout Picker with multi-finger clicks.
- **Native & fast** — pure Swift, Apple Silicon native, designed to stay out of your way in the menu bar.

Available in 10 languages. Core window management is free forever; advanced Pro features come with a 7-day trial and are unlocked via subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later and Accessibility permission.

SeqLog is a native macOS outliner in the Logseq and Roam lineage, built with Swift, SwiftUI, AppKit and a Rust core. No Electron, no web view.

## Your notes stay files

Every note is a plain Markdown file in a folder you choose. There is no database and no index, so the files are the source of truth. Search is ripgrep straight over the folder. Anything else on your Mac, including a coding agent pointed at the vault, reads exactly what SeqLog reads.

## What is in it

- Daily journal you can scroll back through forever
- Block outlining with folding, wikilinks and backlinks
- Full text search across the vault, powered by ripgrep
- An embedded Git client for history, inline diffs, one click revert and sync to any remote
- Slash commands, inline images, and a command palette

## Built for the scroll

Text rendering goes through a hand rolled Core Text draw path with a recycling scroll view rather than a stock list. On a vault holding 400 days of journal entries the 99th percentile frame time measures 8.37 ms against an 8.33 ms budget at 120 Hz.

Free forever on macOS. Signed and notarized, distributed outside the App Store. No account, no telemetry.

## What's inside

- **Licensing that never locks out a paying customer** — keys activated per Mac, rechecked weekly, with a 14-day offline grace window.
- **One command from source to notarized DMG** — preflight, universal build, signing, launch test on Apple silicon and Intel, notarization, stapling and a signed update-feed entry, locally or in the included GitHub workflow.
- **Auto-updates with Sparkle** — a per-product EdDSA key and an appcast signed against the exact bytes of the DMG.
- **Payments through Creem or Polar** — both merchants of record, behind one contract, selected with one setting.
- **The site that sells it** — a Next.js site with pricing, legal pages, lost-key recovery, downloads that follow your releases, an MDX blog, llms.txt and IndexNow.
- **Email that arrives once** — receipts, recovery, refunds, a waitlist and launch broadcasts in React Email, sent through Resend.

## Built for AI agents

The repository is designed to be worked on by coding agents: rule books written from real failures, a machine-readable map of the repo, a doctor that tells you what is left, checks that report file, line and fix, and thirteen Claude Code skills.

Extracted from real shipped Mac apps (MacMemory, Goal Rings, Localdock), with checks written after each failure they prevent.

apps.name: Qampanion
apps.tagline: Build no-code regression and E2E tests for iOS and Android on macOS. Visual editor, device management, snapshot comparison, CLI, and MCP integration.
apps.description:
### What it is

Qampanion is a macOS application for creating and running regression and end-to-end (E2E) tests for mobile applications. It provides a user-friendly interface for test design, device management, and test execution, making it easier for developers and testers to ensure the quality of their mobile applications.

You can also mix in API requests, bash scripts, and reusable linked steps when a pure UI flow isn't enough.

### How Qampanion differs

Most mobile testing tools fall into two camps.

AI-first runners generate a new test plan every time you hit run. That means you pay for tokens on every execution, and small changes can produce different results. Qampanion generates tests once, with or without AI, then runs them statically. Same steps, same screenshots, same outcome every time.

The older enterprise route gives you power, but only if your team writes and maintains test code. Qampanion skips that. You build tests in a visual editor, so a non-technical teammate can create and update cases without opening an IDE.

Everything runs locally on your Mac. Your app, your screenshots, and your test data never leave the machine. The project file is plain and versionable, so you can launch it in CI/CD the same way you launch it locally.

The MCP integration is the bridge between the two worlds. Connect any AI agent, describe the flow you want, and the agent will tap through the app and build the test case for you. After that, the test runs on its own. You can also take an existing iOS test case and adapt it for Android without rebuilding it from scratch.

### Three ways to work

I didn't want another tool that forces a single workflow:

- **Visual editor.** Build tests with clicks. No code.
- **CLI.** Run tests from the terminal or wire them into CI/CD.
- **MCP / AI.** Connect an AI assistant and generate or adjust tests from descriptions.

The idea is simple: start visual, automate the repetition, and let AI speed up the parts that still feel tedious.

Squeezo shrinks, converts and edits your photos, videos, GIFs and PDFs, right on your Mac. Drop a file in, get a smaller one back, and nothing is ever uploaded. There is no account and no tracking, and it works fully offline.

## Hold Shift. Pick an action. Drop.

Drag files from Finder or the Desktop and press **Shift**. A wheel opens under your cursor. Drop on Compress, Convert, Resize, Crop or Remove Background, and Squeezo does it right away, without opening a window. Tools that need options open the main window with your files ready.

## Smaller files, same look

Squeezo picks the right encoder for each format and checks the result. It never hands back a file larger than the one you gave it.

- **Video:** constant-quality HEVC or H.264. HDR stays HDR.
- **Photos:** JPEG, PNG, HEIC and TIFF, up to 76% smaller in our tests.
- **PDFs:** scans shrink a lot, and text stays selectable.
- **GIFs:** palette and frame optimisation keep the animation intact.

Results are sample figures from typical files. Your savings depend on what is in your file.

## One app instead of six

- Compress photos, video, GIFs, PDFs, audio, Word, PowerPoint, Excel and EPUB files
- Convert between JPEG, PNG, HEIC, TIFF, AVIF, PDF, MP4, MOV, GIF and audio formats
- Resize, crop, rotate and flip, with a live preview before you run anything
- Enlarge pictures and videos with sharpening
- Add a text or logo watermark
- Hide faces by blurring, pixelating or covering them
- Remove the background from a photo
- Turn PDFs and pictures into Markdown or plain text, with on-device text recognition
- Merge PDFs, or split one into pages

## Made for your workflow

- **Watched folders:** point Squeezo at a folder and every new screenshot or download is shrunk for you.
- **Undo anything:** replaced originals go to the Trash first, and one click brings them back.
- **Menu bar, Shortcuts and Spotlight:** use it without opening the window.
- **Batch everything:** drop a whole folder and every supported file is queued.

## Private by design

Your files are processed on your Mac and never uploaded. There is no account and no analytics. Squeezo only goes online to check your license and look for updates.

## Pricing

Squeezo is free for 5 files a day, with every tool and format included. A one-time license removes the daily limit, adds watched folders and Shortcuts, works on 2 Macs and includes all updates. There is no subscription. If it is not right for you, email us within 14 days for a refund.

Vocal Notes uses native UI controls, familiar library management, and smooth playback patterns. Local models optimized for Apple Silicon deliver fast performance without cloud latency or transcription-minute limits.

### Who Should Use Vocal Notes?

apps.description:
SiftFrame is a private, local visual memory for Mac. Capture screenshots and screen recordings with flexible tools, then find the exact moment you remember by searching what was visible on screen not just filenames or timestamps.

## Capture it your way

Capture exactly what you need:

- Full display
- Individual windows
- Rectangular areas
- Freeform regions
- Polygon regions
- Timed captures
- Last region
- Screen recordings
- Capture Presets for repeatable workflows

You can also index screenshot folders you already use, so SiftFrame works with both new captures and your existing library.

## Find the moment

On-device OCR makes screenshots searchable and indexes sampled frames from supported screen recordings.

Search across:

- Visible text
- Titles
- Tags
- Source-app hints
- Searchable context
- Dates and local metadata

Instead of remembering a filename like `Screenshot 2026-08-10...`, search for what you actually remember seeing.

## Retrace your work

**Timeline** gives you a visual way to browse screenshots and recordings by when they happened, while **Capture Groups** keep related captures together as one session.

A group might look like:

**Checkout bug investigation — 8 screenshots, 1 recording, 12 minutes**

This works well for debugging, research, support evidence, design reviews, studying, and any workflow that takes more than one capture.

## Remember why you captured it

OCR can tell SiftFrame what was visible, but it cannot know why something mattered to you.

Add searchable context such as:

- Bug in checkout flow
- Design reference
- Research for project
- Compare with next version
- Send this to support later

Names describe *what* a capture is. Context helps you remember *why* you kept it.

## Organize without losing the original

Use:

- Tags and favorites
- Saved searches
- Review Inbox
- Pinned references
- Recording markers and chapters
- Screenshot comparison
- Smart Rules
- Export Bundles
- Global Command Palette

SiftFrame keeps organization centered around local metadata rather than forcing you to restructure your original files.

## Redact before sharing

**Smart Redaction** can suggest sensitive areas for you to review, and you can place and adjust redactions manually.

Redaction creates a non-destructive redacted copy rather than changing your original capture.

*Always review redactions before sharing.*

## Built for Mac power users

SiftFrame includes tools like:

- Global shortcuts
- Command Palette
- Capture Presets
- Advanced capture modes
- Timeline
- Capture Groups
- Pinned references
- Compare Mode
- Smart Rules
- Advanced review workflows

The goal is to provide powerful workflows without turning SiftFrame into a bloated image editor.

## Private by design

Your visual library is designed to stay on your Mac.

- No account
- No backend
- No cloud OCR
- No cloud sync
- No analytics
- No telemetry
- No ads
- No subscription

Recognition, search indexes, context, tags, and library metadata are processed locally unless you explicitly export or share something yourself.

## Free to start

SiftFrame Free includes basic screenshot and screen-recording capture, OCR search, one watched folder, and up to 100 indexed items.

**SiftFrame Pro is a $14.99 USD one-time unlock** for unlimited library growth and advanced capture, Timeline, Groups, organization, redaction, and power-user workflows.

No subscription.

apps.name: MacPacker
apps.tagline: Browse, preview, extract and create archives on macOS
apps.description:
## A native archive manager for macOS

MacPacker is a free, open-source archive manager built specifically for macOS. It lets you browse, preview, search, extract, create and edit archives through a clean, native interface.

Instead of extracting an entire archive just to find one file, MacPacker lets you look inside first. Navigate folders, search for what you need, preview files and drag individual items directly to Finder.

### Why MacPacker exists

MacPacker has been developed for macOS for around three years, gradually growing from a small tool for opening a specific archive format into a full archive manager.

The idea behind: working with archives should not always mean extracting them first. MacPacker treats an archive more like a folder that you can explore. You can navigate its contents, search for files, preview them, open nested archives and extract only what you actually need.

The long-term goal is to bring the flexibility of tools such as 7-Zip and NanaZip to macOS while providing an experience that feels native to the platform.

### What you can do

- Browse archives without extracting them
- Preview individual files and folders
- Search for files inside archives
- Extract only the files you need
- Drag files directly from an archive to Finder
- Browse nested archives
- Open password-protected archives
- Create, edit and save ZIP archives
- Work with split archives
- Use Finder and Quick Look integration
- Browse 40+ archive and disk-image formats

Supported formats include common formats such as ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR and GZ, as well as formats such as CAB, CPIO, WIM, ISO, DMG, VMDK and legacy StuffIt archives.

### Who is it for?

MacPacker is useful for anyone who regularly works with compressed files, but particularly developers, IT professionals and power users who need more than macOS's built-in archive handling provides.

It is equally useful for quickly checking a downloaded ZIP, digging through old backups, inspecting installers and disk images, or finding one file inside a large archive.

### Open source and built for macOS

MacPacker is written in Swift using SwiftUI and AppKit. It has been developed specifically for macOS rather than wrapping a cross-platform interface.

The project is open source and actively developed. MacPacker is free to use, with its source code available on GitHub.

You review it, then click Send and Greetigo emails it to them, or copy it into a text. Nothing is sent without your click.

Greetigo works in any web browser and as a Mac app (macOS 12 or later, Apple silicon and Intel) with Mac notifications. There is no iPhone, Android or Windows app, and no text-message reminders. Free for up to 10 saved dates; Plus is $4.99 a month and Premium $9.99 a month, each with a 7-day free trial for first-time subscribers. No ads. Support: team@greetigo.com.

Familiar by design:
- Enter opens files and folders; F2 renames.

A serious file manager underneath:

FileNav Pro adds a remote/cloud stack: browse and transfer over SFTP/FTP and inside Google Drive, OneDrive, and Dropbox, plus scheduled folder sync.

apps.name: Caesura

apps.description:
Caesura is a menu-bar app for macOS that reminds you to take six kinds of breaks: drink water, walk, stretch your wrists, rest your eyes, check your posture, and breathe. Each one runs on its own schedule, and every default interval comes from a specific study rather than a number I made up.

The problem with running six timers is obvious: on a busy day they gang up on you. Caesura merges any reminders that land within two minutes of each other into a single prompt, so you get one interruption instead of three back to back.

It also knows when to shut up. When your camera is on, you're sharing your screen, an app is fullscreen, or Do Not Disturb is active, every timer pauses and picks up where it left off. It can watch your local calendar too, if you let it.

A few things it deliberately doesn't do:

- No subscription. You buy it once, updates are free.

apps.name: Mute
apps.tagline: Automatic Do Not Disturb the moment a call starts
apps.description:
**Mute automatically turns on Do Not Disturb the moment you're on a call — and turns it off when you hang up.**

macOS Focus mode works, but only if you remember to switch it on before every call and off afterward. Miss it and notifications pop mid-meeting; forget it and you stay silent for hours. Mute ties Do Not Disturb directly to your mic and camera, so it just happens.

### How it works
- **Microphone** — reads CoreAudio's device-in-use signal (the same one behind the orange dot in your menu bar), the instant any app opens your mic.
- **Camera** — observes every connected camera via AVFoundation, built-in or external.
- **Do Not Disturb** — toggled through two bundled macOS Shortcuts calling the native Focus API. No private APIs, no accessibility permissions.

### Why you'll like it
- **Zero configuration** — lives in your menu bar, works out of the box.
- **Works with everything** — Zoom, Teams, Google Meet, FaceTime, Slack, Discord, WebEx, and any browser call. It reads a system signal, not per-app integrations.
- **Choose your trigger** — mic & camera, mic only, or camera only.
- **Private by design** — no data collected, no account, no network. It reads activity state only, never audio or video. Fully open source (MIT).
- **Free.**

apps.description:
Introducing → Folder Hub 

Folder Hub is an app made to fit neatly under the MacBook's notch, letting you quickly access files and folders. 

Why not use Finder directly?
1. Every time I need to access files, I find myself navigating through layers of folders to locate the files below each project folder. 
2. The Finder window often gets obscured by the active working window, such as the browser, making it quite challenging to drag and drop files.

With Folder Hub 

You can create multiple workspaces, each representing a specific project folder. For instance, you can customize a desktop workspace for accessing files on the desktop, where the names and access location are entirely up to you. When you need to retrieve files from the desktop, simply move your mouse to the notch, and the Folder Hub Window will appear. You can open files or even drag and drop files into the browser for uploading.

Through this simple description, the following can be observed:
* Folder Hub floats above all other windows, ensuring it is not obscured by the current active window.
* No need to navigate through nested folders.
* When needing to access it again, Folder Hub remains in the last selected workspace, avoiding the inconvenience of having to find the previously closed Finder window. 

One More Thing

Files and Folders Right at Your Fingertips. That is to say, you can also display the Folder Hub Window at the position of the cursor. This is a faster way to access files.
It's not an alternative to Finder, but compared to navigating through layers of folders in Finder, this method of file access is undoubtedly efficient.
